This is not a pure policy or reporting role. The successful candidate must be comfortable operating close to the technology, challenging complexity, enabling rapid pilots, scaling what works and building the standards required to make AI safe, repeatable and enterprise-ready.


Responsibilities:

Delivery, Product and Business Value

Build and run a portfolio of AI, analytics and data products, prioritizing initiatives with clear business value and measurable outcomes.

Establish data ownership, stewardship, quality standards, metadata practices and trusted-data principles across the organization.
Improve data quality, lineage, accessibility and consistency across core business domains and platforms.
Ensure compliance with applicable data protection, security, privacy, retention and industry requirements.

AI Governance and Responsible AI

Lead practical AI governance that enables responsible innovation rather than slowing delivery.
Define standards for AI use-case intake, risk assessment, knowledge-source validation, model/agent review, access control, monitoring and periodic review.
Ensure AI initiatives meet responsible AI, cybersecurity, privacy, IP protection, auditability and ITGC expectations.
Partner with Legal, HR, Compliance, Cybersecurity and business leaders on sensitive AI use cases and risk-based controls.

Operating Model, COE and Adoption

Lead the Data & AI Office as a center of excellence that provides standards, enablement, reusable components and delivery support.
Operate a hub-and-spoke model with business AI Champions, process owners and functional teams.
Build data literacy and AI adoption through playbooks, coaching, training and practical examples.
Recruit, develop and retain a high-performing team across data engineering, analytics, data governance, data science, AI engineering and business analysis.

Operations, Budget and Performance

Manage the Data & AI budget, vendor relationships, platform consumption and licensing in line with value delivered.

Ensure production AI and data capabilities have clear ownership, lifecycle management, monitoring, support and continuous improvement.

Excellent executive communication skills, including the ability to translate technical topics into business value, risk and investment decisions.
Hands-on technologist with builder mentality
Business translator with change management attitude
Governance-minded enabler
Fluent in English
Additional language skills considered an asset

Experience with Microsoft ecosystem including Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Power Platform, Copilot Studio and M365 Copilot.
Experience in industrial, manufacturing, engineering, aftermarket, supply chain or complex B2B environments.
Experience building or operating an AI Center of Excellence, data office, analytics CoE or hub-and-spoke delivery model.

Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

title: Information Security Officer (m/f)
description:
Information Security Officer

About Luxtrust

We are a multicultural and forward-thinking qualiﬁed Trust Services Provider based in Capellen, Luxembourg, with over 110 professionals and actively expanding our business internationally. We provide state-of-the-art on on-boarding, digital identities, strong authentication and security services, and qualiﬁed electronic signatures, all bundled into integrated digital documents & identity management solutions.

As a Trusted Partner, we prioritize building long-lasting relationships with our international clients and stakeholders, based on trust and integrity. We strive to be a Committed Partner, dedicating ourselves to delivering exceptional performance and showing steadfast commitment to make a positive impact. As a Visionary Scout, we are constantly seeking out new opportunities for growth and innovation, always staying ahead of the curve in our industry.

Join us in our mission to drive innovation and co-create a better future!

We are currently looking for a motivated and driven Information Security Officer.

Summary

This role contributes to improve IT security controls effectiveness, increase ISMS process maturity and keep IT risks exposure under accepted level by assisting the Chief Information Security Officer in its missions.

Missions of the role

• Security Operation activities such as vulnerability management; threats monitoring; threat prevention (phishing tentative, SIEM alerts) and log review. Improve threat detection capabilities by reviewing SIEM use cases on a regular basis in closed collaboration with our SOC partner.
• The security recurring controls annual plan such as access right reviews, suppliers due diligence, Supplier Review Meetings, hardening guide and CIS conformity audits of IT.
• Involved in penetration-testing campaign on corporate environment. Defines pen-testing scope, prepare and coordinate pen-testers activities, review pen-testing results with IT department and manage recommendations action plan.
• LuxTrust security controls: contribute to annual supplier due diligence assessment, represent department in the Compliance and audit exercises and maintain our security controls documentation accordingly.
• Security incident: Involved in security Incident review, problem review and associated KPIs / KRIs reporting.
• Contribute to an ongoing, proactive risk assessment program for all new and existing systems in our corporate environment and ensure that effective controls to manage these risks are in place against the company's goals and business processes.
• Participate in Audit ISO27001 and any other audits applicable to LuxTrust entities.
• Manages security awareness annual program.
• Implements security improvements by assessing current situation; evaluating trends; anticipating requirements; evaluation security incidents.
•  Provide Information Security advisory to both IT and Business units by assisting Legal, Compliance and Sales teams in due diligence exercises, new process flow or use cases and any security questions. Lead supplier due diligence assessment for the security aspects.
•  Maintain and improve ISMS documentation based on knowledge of best practices, regulatory requirements and specific needs of LuxTrust. Involved in procedures development and maintain it on annual basis. Participate to the Policy/Standards document review.
•  Assist the IT team in performing risk assessment related to technology implementation :
o Perform research and coordination with IT to drive security
o Perform research and recommendation of appropriate security protection products and services, such as log management, security event management, and intrusion detection
•  Project management of any related project.

Required skills

Qualifications / diploma(s): Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Information Security or related experience.

Years of experience in the area:

• 5+ years of experience in Information Technology with security focus.
• Experience in developing, documenting and maintaining policies, processes, procedures and standards
• Prior security audit experience would be an asset
• Knowledge of and experience in understanding documentation and regulatory compliance requirements is an asset.

Technical competencies:

• Skills and knowledge of IT, networks and Information security business
• PKI knowledge is an asset

Languages: French and English fluent. Any other language is an asset.

Specific skills:

• Strong analytical skills to analyze information security requirements and relate them to appropriate controls
• Organized, responsive, accountable and highly thorough of problem solving oriented and solution driven
• Ability to synthesize
• Proactive attitude
• Good team player and positive attitude in a challenging environment
• Strong communication and writing skills
• Foster teamwork and collaboration

Core competencies at LuxTrust:

• Analytical mindset & decision making
• Organizational fluency
• Personal effectiveness
• Results-driven
• Client service mindset
• Strategic vision
• Leadership

What we offer

• A permanent contract based in Capellen - Luxembourg
• A competitive salary, in accordance with your education and experience.
• Attractive benefits and advantages including an employee benefit plan, a gym, meal vouchers and additional holidays.
• A healthy work-life balance including flex work arrangements.
• Parking spaces for all employees.
• An open and transparent career path.
• Development and growth opportunities in a state-of-the art digital company.

Our company is committed to fair recruitment, based on the skills of each candidate, regardless of gender nationality, sexual orientation, religion, or any other discriminatory criterion.

Please note that in order to comply with our regulatory requirements an extract of the criminal record is requested upon entry into service.

title: Job på Malta - Vil du arbejde med administrativ kundeservice med Igaming? - Book en samtale i dag!
description:
Drømmer du om at kombinere et socialt arbejdsliv med sol, hav og et ungt dansk team? Har du lyst til at arbejde i et miljø, hvor tempo, samarbejde og personlighed betyder lige så meget som erfaring? Så har du muligheden for at blive en del af et lille, tæt dansk team i Sliema, hvor du arbejder med kundesupport for flere etablerede brands.

Du bliver en vigtig del af et team på otte danske kolleger, hvor man lægger stor vægt på personlighed, trivsel og fællesskab. Her handler det ikke kun om at yde god kundeservice — men også om at fungere godt socialt, bidrage til stemningen og være en del af et miljø, hvor man både arbejder og laver ting sammen uden for kontoret.

Vi leder efter en udadvendt og engageret person, der motiveres af at skabe gode kundeoplevelser og som trives i et miljø, hvor man hurtigt bliver en del af fællesskabet.

Hvad laver en Customer Support Representative?

Du besvarer kundehenvendelser via e-mail og chat og sikrer, at hver kunde får en professionel og hjælpsom oplevelse. Du hjælper med teknisk support, guider kunder gennem platformen og sørger for, at eventuelle problemer bliver løst hurtigt og korrekt. Du overvåger også hjemmesidens funktionalitet og rapporterer fejl eller driftsproblemer til teamlederen. Derudover hjælper du med at promovere nye produkter og kampagner og støtter teamet i ad hoc-opgaver, når der er behov.

Du bliver en del af et mindre, socialt team, hvor personlighed og samarbejde vægtes højt — og hvor fredagsbar, fælles frokost og sociale aktiviteter er en naturlig del af kulturen.

Bidrager til teamet og udviklingen

Du er med til at skabe en god stemning i teamet og bidrager til, at hverdagen fungerer. Du deler viden, støtter nye kolleger og hjælper med at sikre, at teamet arbejder effektivt og med høj kvalitet. Da teamet er lille, har du mulighed for hurtigt at få mere ansvar og udvikle dig i rollen. Du bliver en vigtig del af et fællesskab, hvor man hjælper hinanden, og hvor personlighed og teamfit er afgørende.

Dit ansvar:

  • Kundesupport via e-mail og chat

  • Teknisk vejledning og fejlfinding

  • Overvågning af platformens funktionalitet

  • Rapportering af driftsproblemer

  • Hjælp til kampagner og produktinformation

  • Vidensdeling og støtte til nye kolleger

  • Opdatering af interne systemer og kundehistorik

  • Ad hoc-opgaver efter behov

Dine kvalifikationer:

  • Taler og skriver dansk og godt engelsk

  • Udadvendt, social og trives i et ungt team

  • Har øje for detaljer og arbejder struktureret

  • Motiveret for at lære — erfaring er ikke et krav

  • Bonus: Erfaring med kundeservice eller kendskab til casino-/iGaming-branchen

  • Evne til at håndtere flere opgaver og bevare overblikket

Da teamet kun består af otte danske kolleger, lægger man stor vægt på personlighed og på, hvordan du fungerer i fællesskabet. Du skal trives i et miljø, hvor man både arbejder sammen og laver ting sammen uden for arbejdstiden.

  • Årsløn: 27.000 EUR

  • Relocationpakke

  • Løn stiger efter oplæring/kvalifikation

  • Ca. 15 % skat

  • 40 timer om ugen

  • Rotation mellem 08.00 – 21.00

  • 22 feriedage om året

  • Sundhedsforsikring

  • Danske ledere og et stabilt team

  • Gode lokale deals på fitness, sprogkurser m.m.

Karrieremæssige fordele:

  • Internationale muligheder – Malta er et globalt knudepunkt for tech- og iGaming-industrien, hvilket giver adgang til et bredt netværk af virksomheder og karrieremuligheder.

  • Erhvervserfaring i et voksende marked, en vigtig del af den digitale verden, og erfaring inden for dette felt kan åbne døre til fremtidige roller i tech, compliance og kundeservice.

  • Udvikling af værdifulde færdigheder – Du vil opbygge kompetencer inden for kommunikation, problemløsning og digital sikkerhed, som er eftertragtede på arbejdsmarkedet.

  • Mulighed for karrierevækst – Mange virksomheder i Malta tilbyder interne udviklingsprogrammer og karriereforløb, så du kan avancere i din rolle.

Livet på Malta:

  • Middelhavslivsstil – Malta byder på en afslappet livsstil med smukke strande, historiske byer og en livlig expat-community.

  • Engelsk som arbejdssprog – Engelsk er et af de officielle sprog i Malta, hvilket gør det nemt at integrere sig både socialt og professionelt.

  • Lav kriminalitet og god sikkerhed – Malta har en af de laveste kriminalitetsrater i Europa, hvilket gør det til et trygt sted at bo.

  • Leveomkostninger – Leveomkostningerne er generelt lavere end i mange andre europæiske lande, især når det kommer til bolig og dagligvarer.

Skat på Malta:

  • Attraktive skatteforhold – Malta har en gunstig skattepolitik for expats, hvor indkomstskat kan være så lav som 15 % for visse erhvervsgrupper.

  • Ingen ejendomsskat – Der er ingen årlig ejendomsskat, hvilket kan være en fordel for dem, der ønsker at investere i bolig.

  • Lav selskabsskat – Hvis du senere ønsker at starte din egen virksomhed, har Malta en af de mest konkurrencedygtige skatteordninger i EU.

Klimaet på Malta:

  • Solrigt året rundt – Malta har over 300 solskinsdage om året, hvilket gør det til et af de mest solrige steder i Europa.

  • Milde vintre – Selv i januar falder temperaturen sjældent under 10°C, hvilket betyder, at du kan nyde udendørslivet året rundt.

  • Varme somre – Sommeren kan blive varm med temperaturer op til 35°C, men den friske havbrise gør det behageligt.

At arbejde på Malta giver dig ikke kun en spændende karrierevej, men også en fantastisk livsstil i et solrigt og dynamisk miljø. Lyder det som noget for dig?

title: Legal & Compliance Manager (B2B) - Malta
description:
Come and join our journey!

A taste of what you’ll do

As a Legal & Compliance Manager (B2B), you will serve as a primary legal and compliance contact for business-to-business affairs, supporting a broad range of contractual, regulatory, and gambling compliance responsibilities across multiple jurisdictions.

Accountabilities:

    Act as a primary legal partner for B2B affairs, leading day-to-day contractual reviews, negotiations, and drafting of a broad range of commercial agreements and related documentation.
    Lead the preparation, review, and negotiation of commercial contracts using and refining standard templates, including platform and content supply, software licensing, distribution, and reseller arrangements.
    Provide clear, commercially focused legal advice to management, presenting legal risks, practical options, and strategic recommendations to support informed decision-making.
    Collaborate cross-functionally with the broader Group legal and compliance function to support business objectives.
    Manage the preparation, submission, and ongoing maintenance of gaming licence applications across multiple jurisdictions, taking ownership of assigned portfolios.
    Verify that prospective and existing B2B clients hold valid gambling licences or authorisations in each market in which products or services will be deployed, and monitor counterparty licence status, regulatory standing, and market exits throughout the relationship lifecycle.
    Maintain the approved-markets framework, advising on market permissibility and regulated versus unregulated market positioning, and ensuring territory and geo-restriction requirements are reflected in commercial agreements.
    Support proactive and collaborative relationships with regulatory authorities, as needed.
    Manage ongoing licence maintenance obligations across the B2B licence portfolio, including key event reporting, regulatory notifications, periodic returns, and compliance and system audits.
    Act as holder of key functions and/or personal management licences, as applicable, across relevant jurisdictions, subject to regulatory approval and applicable vetting requirements.
    Monitor regulatory developments affecting B2B supply, assessing the impact of new and emerging supplier licensing regimes and feeding outcomes into market entry, certification, and licensing strategies.
    Create, update, implement, monitor, and enforce policies, procedures, guidelines, and manuals.
    Oversee technical compliance requirements, including managing relationships with accredited test laboratories, owning the certification and homologation roadmap for each jurisdiction, and coordinating security audits and product certification.
    Manage regulatory change-management processes for game and platform releases, coordinating with product and technical teams on certification, notification, and remediation requirements.
    Ensure content and brand protection by registration, maintenance, and renewal of intellectual property rights by assisting in any IP disputes that may arise from time to time, and developing and implementing a domain name strategy.
    Own the B2B counterparty onboarding and due diligence framework, including Know Your Business (KYB) and Customer Due Diligence (CDD) on prospective clients and suppliers, sanctions and adverse media screening, and anti-bribery and corruption due diligence on commercial partners and intermediaries.
    Advise on data protection matters arising in B2B arrangements, including controller–processor analysis, negotiation of data processing agreements, and international data transfer requirements, in coordination with the Group’s data protection function.
    Perform other job-related functions as assigned.

Qualifications

    Qualified lawyer with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Law (LLB or equivalent).

Required Skills

    1–3 years’ post-qualification experience in regulatory, legal, or advisory roles, within B2B iGaming.
    Demonstrated experience in multi-jurisdictional gambling regulation and licensing, including the preparation and management of licence applications and regulatory submissions.
    Demonstrated experience drafting and negotiating B2B commercial agreements, such as platform and content supply, software licensing, distribution, and reseller arrangements.
    Familiarity with B2B/supplier licensing and authorisation regimes, as distinct from operator licensing, and with technical compliance and certification frameworks, including working with accredited test laboratories.
    Eligibility and willingness to undergo regulatory vetting and to hold key function or personal management licence appointments, as required; prior experience holding such appointments is advantageous.
    Experience providing independent regulatory advice to internal business stakeholders.
    Working knowledge of data protection requirements in a B2B contracting context, including data processing agreements and international transfers.
    Exposure to intellectual property portfolio management, brand protection, or counterparty due diligence (KYB/CDD, sanctions screening) is advantageous.

Preferred Skills

    Strong legal research, analysis, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and address regulatory issues independently.
    Sound commercial drafting and negotiation skills across a broad range of B2B agreement types.
    Ability to interpret complex regulatory requirements and translate them into clear, practical, and commercially sound advice.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present regulatory analysis to non-legal audiences.
    Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage a varied and demanding workload, prioritise effectively, and meet deadlines.
    High level of professionalism, integrity, and attention to detail.
    Fluency in English is required; proficiency in an additional language is advantageous.

Über uns

Die RCT Energy Technology GmbH mit Sitz in Konstanz ist ein technologieorientiertes Unternehmen im Bereich Energiespeichersysteme und intelligenter Energielösungen.

Unser Tätigkeitsfeld umfasst Energiespeichersysteme, Wechselrichter, Batterielösungen und Energiemanagementsysteme für private, gewerbliche, industrielle und großtechnische Anwendungen. Dabei stehen technische Innovation, Produktqualität, zuverlässige Projektabwicklung und die Anforderungen unserer Kunden im Mittelpunkt.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen After-Sales Engineer (m/w/d) für Batteriespeichersysteme mit Arbeitsort in den Niederlanden.

Ihre Aufgaben

• Sicherstellung eines hochwertigen technischen Supports und Projektmanagements für unsere CESS-Systeme und gewerblichen Speicherlösungen.
• Planung und Koordination von Installations- und Inbetriebnahmeeinsätzen in Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Partnern.
• Überwachung und Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Service-Level-Agreements (SLA) sowie Wartungsvereinbarungen.
• Analyse und Behebung technischer Störungen per Remote-Support oder vor Ort einschließlich der Organisation der erforderlichen Ersatzteilversorgung.
• Technische Unterstützung von Installationspartnern während der Inbetriebnahme von Systemen per Remote-Support oder vor Ort.
• Aufbau und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung eines projektbezogenen Berichtssystems zur Nachverfolgung und Optimierung der Supportprozesse.
• Bearbeitung technischer Anfragen über das zentrale Servicepostfach sowie systematische Erfassung und Nachverfolgung der Vorgänge im Ticketsystem.
• Bearbeitung und Nachverfolgung von Rückgabe- und Reklamationsverfahren (RMA) für CESS- und RESS-Systeme.

Ihr Profil

• Erfolgreich abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung oder ein Studium, vorzugsweise in Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.
• Erfahrung im technischen Kundensupport oder im Servicebereich von Energiespeichersystemen ist von Vorteil.
• Qualifikationen wie VCA, NEN 3140 VP und NEN 1010 sind von Vorteil.
• Ausgeprägte Problemlösungsfähigkeit sowie eine strukturierte und kundenorientierte Arbeitsweise.
• Teamfähigkeit, Organisationstalent und ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit.
• Arbeits- beziehungsweise Wohnort in den Niederlanden sowie die Bereitschaft, unsere Geschäftstätigkeiten innerhalb der Europäischen Union per Remote-Support oder vor Ort zu unterstützen.
• Sehr gute Englisch- oder Deutschkenntnisse; Chinesischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.
• Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Dienstreisen.
• Gültiger Führerschein und praktische Fahrerfahrung; ein eigenes Fahrzeug ist von Vorteil.

• Eine anspruchsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einem dynamischen und zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen der erneuerbaren Energien.
• Die Möglichkeit, innovative großtechnische Batteriespeicherlösungen aktiv mitzugestalten und einen Beitrag zu einer nachhaltigen Energiezukunft zu leisten.
• Ein teamorientiertes Arbeitsumfeld mit flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.

description:
In het kort: Je gaat als consulent Goed Verhuurderschap verhuursituaties onderzoeken, toezicht houden op naleving van wetgeving, beschikkingen en rapportages opstellen en processen verbeteren binnen het loket voor huurders en verhuurders.
Gemeente Ede, smaakmakers van de Veluwe
Ede is veelzijdig: wonen, werken, recreëren kent in Ede vele smaken. Van het levendig centrum in de stad Ede tot het gevarieerde buitengebied en de natuur van de Veluwe. Een groot gebied met dorpen [6711] en stad. We kijken hoe we inwoners verder helpen door goed te luisteren. En geven duidelijk aan wat we te bieden hebben. Wist je dat we bij onze gemeente de nadruk op voedsel en gezondheid leggen? Tegelijkertijd focussen we met zo’n 1100 collega’s op andere belangrijke zaken. Denk aan het zorgen voor voldoende woningen en het werken aan leefbaarheid en duurzaamheid. Voor iedereen, want iedereen is welkom. Onze samenleving en omgeving is continu in ontwikkeling, wij bewegen mee en kijken vooruit. Dat maakt ons wendbaar en weerbaar.
Opdracht
De gemeente Ede zoekt voor het loket Goed Verhuurderschap een daadkrachtige Consulent die uitvoering geeft aan het toezicht en de handhaving binnen de Wet goed verhuurderschap. Je beoordeelt zelfstandig of verhuurpraktijken voldoen aan de wettelijke eisen en bent het centrale aanspreekpunt voor zowel huurders als verhuurders. Je hebt een sterke signalerende functie en bent goed op de hoogte van relevante wet- en regelgeving zoals de Huisvestingswet, Woningwet en de Algemene wet bestuursrecht (Awb).
Naast de dagelijkse werkzaamheden binnen het loket wordt van je gevraagd om actief mee te denken met het evalueren van het huidige proces en input te leveren op mogelijke verbeterpunten. Je bent communicatief ijzersterk, kunt regels helder uitleggen en bent schriftelijk bekwaam in het opstellen van juridisch correcte beschikkingen en rapportages. In deze functie staan sterke onderzoeksvaardigheden, conflicthantering en het de-escalerend kunnen optreden bij em.

Het Schoenenkwartier is op zoek naar een Officemanager die ook de persoonlijk assistent (PA) is van onze directeur-bestuurder. We zoeken niet zomaar een medewerker: we zoeken een proactieve collega die het middelpunt van ons team is en veel werk tegelijkertijd kan verzetten. Als Officemanager is geen dag hetzelfde en ontzorg jij de directeur naast de dagelijkse organisatie van ons kantoor en de uitvoering van een breed pakket aan kantoortaken. Van administratieve taken tot de overall-planning van de boekingen en het beantwoorden van inkomende telefoongesprekken. Word jij enthousiast bij het lezen van deze werkzaamheden?

Wie zijn wij?

Wij laten je de wereld van de schoenen ontdekken, zodat je steviger kunt staan. Schoenen zijn meer dan iets wat je draagt; ze zijn een deel van je identiteit, voor jong en oud, arm en rijk, voor elk individu. Schoenen verbinden ons allemaal, in al hun vormen en stijlen. Elk paar vertelt een uniek verhaal, en die verhalen willen we je laten ontdekken.
We prikkelen je om na te denken over jouw eigen schoenen, je te laten dromen over de toekomst van schoenen en hoe ze met respect voor de wereld gemaakt kunnen worden, én geven je ruimte om zelf te creëren en innoveren. Zodat je bewust en vol vertrouwen in je eigen schoenen staat.

title: Vi søker en selgende salgsleder til vår nye B2B-satsing!
description:
Vi søker en selgende salgsleder til vår nye B2B-satsing!

På oppdrag for Telenor skal vi bygge Talkmore B2B sitt råeste salgsteam i Sandefjord. Nå ser vi etter en erfaren telekomselger som vil ta en nøkkelrolle i vår nye satsing.

Vi søker deg som kjenner telekombransjen, kan salg og trigges av muligheten til å bygge, lede og utvikle et nytt salgsteam fra start.

Dette er en rolle for deg som fortsatt elsker å selge. Som selgende salgsleder skal du gå foran i salget, samtidig som du følger opp teamet og bidrar til at menneskene rundt deg lykkes.

Er du klar for neste steg i salgskarrieren?

Rollen som salgsleder

Som selgende salgsleder får du en sentral rolle i oppbyggingen av vårt nye B2B-team i Sandefjord.

Du vil representere vår samarbeidspartner Talkmore og jobbe med produkter og tjenester fra Talkmore Bedrift mot SMB-markedet.

Du skal selv være aktiv i salget, samtidig som du har ansvar for å skape struktur, energi og resultater i teamet.

Dine viktigste oppgaver vil være å:

  • Drive aktivt B2B-salg og gå foran som et godt eksempel

  • Lede, motivere og følge opp selgerne i teamet

  • Coache medarbeidere og bidra til utvikling av salgsferdigheter

  • Følge opp mål, aktivitet og resultater

  • Bidra i onboarding og opplæring av nye selgere

  • Bygge gode salgsrutiner og en sterk prestasjonskultur

  • Jobbe tett med ledelsen om videre utvikling og vekst av satsingen

Vi tilbyr

  • Fastlønn + markedets beste provisjoner

  • Gode Bonusordninger

  • En nøkkelrolle i oppbyggingen av vår nye satsing i Sandefjord

  • Muligheten til å bygge og utvikle ditt eget salgsteam

  • Stor påvirkningskraft på hvordan teamet og satsingen utvikles

  • Grundig opplæring og tett samarbeid med ledelsen

  • Gode utviklingsmuligheter og mer ansvar i takt med resultatene

  • Et sosialt, ambisiøst og resultatorientert arbeidsmiljø

  • Muligheten til å representere en av Norges sterkeste merkevarer

  • Lyse, fine og moderne kontorer sentralt ved E18 (Ved Coop Obs).

  • Kantineordning

  • Gratis parkering

Vi ser etter deg som

  • Har solid erfaring med salg innen telekom

  • Har erfaring med B2B-salg, gjerne mot SMB-markedet

  • Kan vise til gode salgsresultater

  • Har god forståelse for salgsprosessen og vet hva som kreves for å lykkes over tid

  • Har et sterkt konkurranseinstinkt og motiveres av tydelige mål

  • Er strukturert, disiplinert og tar eierskap til resultater

  • Trives med å motivere, utvikle og stille krav til andre

  • Ønsker å være operativ og selge selv -- ikke bare lede fra sidelinjen

  • Har forretningsforståelse og ser muligheter hos kunden

  • Snakker flytende norsk

Ledererfaring er en fordel, men ikke et absolutt krav. Har du sterke resultater fra telekomsalg og føler deg klar for å ta steget fra toppselger til salgsleder, ønsker vi også å høre fra deg.

Om jobben

Dette er en selgende salgslederrolle.

Du vil selv jobbe aktivt med oppsøkende B2B-salg, hovedsakelig med telefon som arbeidsverktøy. Samtidig får du ansvar for den daglige oppfølgingen og utviklingen av salgsteamet.

Vi skal bygge et team som presterer på et høyt nivå. Derfor ser vi etter en leder som ikke er redd for å gå foran, ta telefonen selv og vise i praksis hvordan godt salgsarbeid gjøres.

Hvorfor Bundl AS?

Hos Bundl AS får du muligheten til å komme inn tidlig i en ny satsing og sette ditt preg på hvordan den bygges.

Vi tror på tydelige mål, høy aktivitet, sterk kultur og tett oppfølging. Samtidig skal gode prestasjoner belønnes.

For den rette personen er dette en mulighet til å gå inn i en sentral rolle fra start og være med på å bygge opp et salgsteam med store ambisjoner.

Er du en erfaren telekomselger som er klar for mer ansvar?

Da vil vi høre fra deg. Vi intervjuer aktuelle kandidater fortløpende.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Bundl AS er et selskap i vekst som jobber med møtebooking, salg, rekruttering og outsourcing av salgsprosjekter for bedrifter over hele Norge. Siden oppstarten i 2024 har vi hatt fokus på å bygge sterke salgsmiljøer, levere gode resultater for våre samarbeidspartnere og skape utviklingsmuligheter for våre ansatte.

Ledelsen i Bundl AS har samlet over 100 års erfaring innen salg, markedsføring og møtebooking. Denne erfaringen bruker vi aktivt for å utvikle både selskapet og menneskene som jobber hos oss.

Vi mener at våre ansatte er vår viktigste ressurs. Derfor investerer vi tungt i opplæring, kompetanseutvikling og tett oppfølging, slik at alle hos oss får verktøyene, kunnskapen og støtten de trenger for å lykkes.

Hos Bundl AS får du muligheten til å utvikle deg i et ambisiøst og resultatorientert miljø med høyt tempo, sterke karrieremuligheter og fokus på personlig vekst.

Sauda Bilverkstad AS søker kunde mottaker i 100 % vikariat ( 12 måneder) med mulighet for forlengelse. Oppstart august 2026.Som kunde mottaker er du verkstedets ansikt utad og en viktig kontaktperson for våre kunder. Vi ser etter deg som trives med å yte god service og liker en hektisk hverdag

Hva vi ser etter

Vi ser etter deg som :

  • Er service innstilt, positiv og imøtekommende.

  • Du er strukturert og har gode samarbeidsevner.

  • Er komfortabel med bruk av ulike dataprogrammer og lærer nye systemer raskt

  • Trives med å ha mange oppgaver samtidig og kunne jobbe i et hektisk miljø

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Mottak og oppfølging av kunder

  • Planlegging og koordinering av timebestillinger

  • Oppfølging av verkstedets kundeportefølje

  • Utarbeidelse av tilbud

  • Fakturering

  • Bistå md taksering av skadede biler

  • Andre administrative oppgaver ved behov


Vi tilbyr

  • Vi tilbyr et 100 % vikariat i 12 måneder med mulighet for forlengelse.

  • Konkurransedyktig lønn

  • Opplæring vil bli gjort

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sauda Bilverkstad ble etablert sommeren 2014. Vi flyttet inn i nye lokaler sommeren 2016 på industriområdet Birkeland-Sauda. Vi er godkjent som bilverksted 01 og skade verksted 02 hos Statens vegvesen. Dette innebærer at vi kan reparere alle bilmerker inkludert utføre alle skade reperasjoner med karosseri etc.

title: Bilmekaniker (PST) – Bli en del av Volvo Car Fornebu sitt nyoppussede verksted
description:
Vil du ha en jobb hvor du kombinerer bilteknikk, kundekontakt og ansvar? Volvo Car Fornebu søker en Personlig Servicetekniker til et nyoppusset og moderne verksted. Her får du en variert arbeidshverdag, gode utviklingsmuligheter og blir en viktig del av kundeopplevelsen.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi ser etter deg som ønsker mer enn en tradisjonell mekanikerjobb.

Vi tror du vil trives hos oss dersom du:

  • Har fagbrev som bilmekaniker (lette kjøretøy)

  • Har førerkort klasse B

  • Er kvalitetsbevisst og løsningsorientert

  • Trives med både kundekontakt og tekniske utfordringer

  • Jobber strukturert og tar ansvar for egne oppgaver

  • Har interesse for moderne bilteknologi og elektriske biler

  • Behersker norsk, både muntlig og skriftlig

Erfaring med Volvo er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Vi sørger for nødvendig opplæring.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som Personlig Servicetekniker (PST) følger du kunden gjennom hele verkstedbesøket. Du får ansvar for både det tekniske arbeidet og dialogen med kunden, noe som gir en mer variert og selvstendig arbeidshverdag enn en tradisjonell mekanikerrolle.

Du vil blant annet:

  • Utføre service, vedlikehold og reparasjoner på Volvo

  • Feilsøke og diagnostisere moderne kjøretøy

  • Planlegge og koordinere egne arbeidsoppgaver

  • Bestille deler ved behov

  • Følge opp egne kunder fra innlevering til utlevering

  • Informere kunden om utført arbeid og eventuelle anbefalinger

  • Bidra til høy kvalitet og gode kundeopplevelser

  • Samarbeide tett med dyktige kollegaer i et sterkt fagmiljø

Vi tilbyr

Hos Volvo Car Fornebu blir du en del av et selskap med høye ambisjoner, moderne løsninger og fokus på både faglig og personlig utvikling.

Vi tilbyr:

  • Fast stilling hos en av Norges største Volvo-forhandlere

  • Et nyoppusset og moderne verksted med den nyeste teknologien

  • En variert arbeidshverdag med stort ansvar

  • Gode utviklings- og karrieremuligheter

  • Opplæring og kurs gjennom Volvo Cars

  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser

  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

  • Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med dyktige og engasjerte kollegaer

Hos oss får du muligheten til å utvikle deg faglig samtidig som du blir en viktig del av et team som setter både medarbeidere og kunder i sentrum.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sky Rekruttering AS bistår Volvo Car Stor-Oslo i rekrutteringen av deres nye Personlige Servicetekniker til Fornebu.

Volvo Car Stor-Oslo er en av Norges største Volvo-forhandlere med over 200 ansatte og avdelinger på Fornebu, Økern, Ryen og Lillestrøm. Selskapet har et sterkt fokus på kvalitet, kompetanseutvikling og gode kundeopplevelser.

Hos Volvo Car Stor-Oslo står menneskene i sentrum. Med visjonen <<Det beste vertskap i alle opplevelser>> jobber de hver dag for å skape gode opplevelser for både kunder og medarbeidere. Du blir en del av et moderne og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med høy fagkompetanse, hvor samarbeid, utvikling og kvalitet står i fokus.

Rekrutteringen gjennomføres av Sky Rekruttering AS. Har du spørsmål om stillingen, ta gjerne kontakt med Gøran Andersen, Senior Talent Acquisition Consultant.

title: Massasjeterapeut søkes
description:
Vi søker en massasjeterapeut eller en med fysikalsk behandling som kan passe inn i vårt hyggelige team på Strand Hudpleie & Velvære. Du må ha utdanning innen massasje/ fysikalske behandlinger og gjerne erfaring fra klinikk, spa, treningssenter eller lignende.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi søker en engasjert og dyktig massasjeterapeut som kan kundeservice og har god forståelse på anatomi, muskel/skjelettplager. Som ønsker å bidra til våre kunders helse, velvære og trivsel. Hos oss får du jobbe i et faglig miljø med fokus på kvalitet, service og god kundeopplevelse.

Hvis du vil jobb deltid er det også mulig å dele behandlingsrom.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Utføre ulike typer massasje på klassisk massasje, avspenningsmassasje, triggerpunktbehandling og idrettsmassasje er et pluss.

Kartlegge kundens ønsker og behov gjennom samtale og vurdering av muskelspenninger og plager.

Gi råd om egenpleie, øvelser eller forebyggende tiltak etter behandling.

Bidra til å skape en trygg, profesjonell og avslappende atmosfære.

ivareta hygiene, rengjøring av behandlingsrom og utstyr.

Håndtere timebestillinger, rebookinger, kundebehandling og administrasjon ved behov.

Være selv aktiv på markedsføring og bidra til å få kunder til behandling.

Samarbeide med kollegaer og bidra til et godt arbeidsmiljø.

Vi tilbyr

Vi er et lite team med hudterapeut, autorisert fotterapeut + 2 leger som leier seg inn i klinikken. Vi flytter nå inn i nytt lokale i Storgaten 19, rett ovenfor biblioteket. Så her vil du bli godt synlig på gateplan.

Du kan få egen tilgang på vår onlinebooking som kunder kan bestille time på og sammen vil hjelpe deg med å bygge opp en kundegruppe.

Vi selger gavekort som bidrar til flere kunder og aktiv på sosiale medier + egen hjemmeside.

Vårt lokale er midt i Tønsberg sentrum på gateplan fra midten av Mai i nyoppusset lokaler på 120 kvm.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vi flytter nå inn i nyoppusset lokale i Storgaten 19.

Strand Hudpleie & Velvære åpnet i Tønsberg i 2011. Vi har vært i samme lokale hele tiden. Vi hadde navneendring fra Tittins til Strand i 2022. Men med samme eier.

Det er vi som hudterapeuter som har drevet mest med massasje. Siden klinikken nå flytter til nytt lokale er det mulighet for den rette å få leie seg inn,der du får et stort og pent behandlingsrom med stort vindu. Og du kan profilere deg ut mot storgaten. Vi merker etterspørsel på massasje/ fysikalske behandlinger er et behov hos oss.

Strand Hudpleie & Velvære profilerer seg som en helse og velvære bedrift. Vi har i tillegg butikk med salg av hudpleieprodukter som Dermalogica, Genosys, Noon, Coola Solserie, Stone Soap Spa og Akeleine fotprodukter.

Disse varemerkene er av kvalitet og trekker også inn kunder på drop-in.

title: Vil du forhindre brann og sikre verdier?
employer: INGENIØR IVAR PETTERSEN AS AVD DRAMMEN
description:
Ingeniør Ivar Pettersen fortsetter sin vellykkede satsing på brannvarsling! TEGG Service avdelingen ble etablert i 2007 og har blitt anerkjent som en ledende aktør innen internkontroll elektro, elektrotermografi og installasjon av brannalarm. Satsingen på brannalarm er en del av Ingeniør Ivar Pettersens langsiktige strategi og vekstplaner. I dag består avdelingen av 30 engasjerte medarbeidere fordelt på våre lokasjoner i Oslo og Drammen. Servicelederne beskriver TEGG-avdelingen som et sterkt fagmiljø, med gode sparringspartnere og driftige mennesker som opplever jobben sin som meningsfull. Som servicetekniker hos oss vil du være med på å sikre verdier og skape en tryggere hverdag.


Hvordan er arbeidshverdagen som servicetekniker?

Som servicetekniker hos TEGG Service vil du ha en variert arbeidshverdag, med hovedfokus på service, årskontroller, kundeoppfølging og mersalg . Du vil blant annet utføre utskiftninger og utbedringer på brannalarmanlegg. Videre vil du dokumentere og rapportere etter utført jobb. Dine arbeidsoppgaver vil variere fra oppdrag på rammeavtaler på offentlige bygg til service og årskontroller på kontor- og næringsbygg. Jobbene fordeles av koordinator eller serviceleder, men teknikerne avtaler direkte med kunden når kontrollen eller servicen skal gjennomføres. Som tekniker vil du ha stor frihet til å planlegge arbeidsdagen din selv. Serviceleder er operativ leder for teknikerne, mens avdelingsleder har personalansvaret.

Ansvarsområder og sentrale arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Bidra til opprettholdelse av gode kunderelasjoner sammen med våre selgere.

  • Idriftsettelse, utbedring, utskiftning, programmering, samt service og årskontroller på brannalarmanlegg.

  • Rapportere og dokumentere utførte oppgaver i henhold til Pettersen sine rutiner.

  • Bistå med opplæring av kolleger eller lærlinger.

  • Ansvar som BAS på ulike prosjekter


Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Fagbrev som elektriker, gruppe L, eller telekommunikasjonsmontør.

  • Ønskelig med FG750-sertifisering, eller villighet til å ta denne.

  • Førerkort klasse B.

  • Gode kommunikasjonsevner på norsk og engelsk, både muntlig og skriftlig.


Hvem ser vi etter?
Vi ser etter en strukturert og nøyaktig tekniker som følger prosedyrer og dokumenterer arbeidet sitt grundig. Du bør være teknisk nysgjerrig og løsningsorientert, med evne til å forstå elektriske systemer og feilsøke på en praktisk og effektiv måte. Det er en fordel om du er selvstendig og ansvarsbevisst, ettersom du vil jobbe en god del selvstendig. Jobben innebærer noe fysisk arbeid, så du bør ha god fysisk utholdenhet. Videre ser vi etter deg som har gode kommunikasjonsevner og effektivt kan forklare tekniske løsninger til ulike målgrupper og yte utmerket kundeservice.

Du vil bli tatt godt imot og få nødvendig opplæring for å føle deg trygg i din nye rolle. Ingeniør Ivar Pettersen er opptatt av å støtte din faglige utvikling, og for den rette kandidaten kan vi tilby relevant kursing og etterutdanning. Vi har også et godt sosialt miljø med regelmessige aktiviteter i løpet av året. Har du noen forslag til hva vår neste aktivitet bør være?

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Ingeniør Ivar Pettersen AS har, siden oppstarten i 1903, opparbeidet en meget solid posisjon som en ledende elektroentreprenør i Oslo, Akershus, Buskerud, Østfold, Vestfold, Telemark og Innlandet. Vi har våre kontorer i Drammen (hovedkontor), Bærum, Oslo, Moss, Sandefjord og Brumunddal.
Vi er til sammen ca. 240 ansatte.

Gjennom strategiske satsninger har vi i dag solid fagkunnskap innen en rekke nisjer innenfor elektrofaget.
Vi leverer elektroinstallasjoner, elektrikerservice, automatiserte systemer for energisparing, brannvarslingssystemer for næring og boliger, industriautomatisering, industriell elektrovarme, solcelleanlegg og elbillading. Tjenestene og systemene leveres både til eiendom, industri, bygg- og anlegg, kommunale- og offentlige virksomheter samt privatboliger. Vårt mål er å kunne tilby våre kunder totalleveranser innenfor de fleste elektroområder.

title: 🚦 Vi trenger flere trafikkjenter fra høsten!🚦
description:
Er du typen som ikke lar deg skremme av litt regn, gule verneklær og ansvar for et par hundre biler før lunsj? Bra! Da kan det hende vi leter etter akkurat deg!

Hos Trafikkjentene AS sørger vi for flyt, sikkerhet og smidige løsninger – enten det er midt i rushen eller på en stille landevei.

Hva vi ser etter

👷 Hvem er du?

Vi bryr oss mer om hvem du er enn hva som står på CV-en. Men du må:

  • Ha førerkort klasse B (manuelt gir er gull, BE er bonus)

  • Snakke og skrive flytende norsk (krav iht. Statens vegvesen håndbok N301)

  • Være digital

  • Være robust og ha god helse - både fysisk og mentalt

  • Synes frisk luft er bedre enn kontorluft

  • Være punktlig (vi kan ikke be trafikken vente fordi du trykket "slumre")

  • Løse problemer raskt og ta ansvar når det gjelder

  • Være fleksibel - ingen dager er like hos oss

  • Ha god arbeidsmoral og møte utfordringer med et smil

  • Kunne jobbe minimum 3 dager i uken primært på dagtid i ukedager

Arbeidsoppgaver

🚧Hva går jobben ut på?

Du blir en del av et team som:

  • Leder trafikken trygt og effektivt forbi arbeidsområder

  • Kommuniserer med kollegaer via samband

  • Er "det ekstra øyet" for sjåfører med store blindsoner

  • Jobber som anleggsvakt og ivaretar sikkerheten på anleggsområder

Vi jobber hovedsakelig i Oslo og Viken, med oppmøte på vårt kontor på Brobekk i Oslo før oppdrag.

Dette er ikke en 08-16 jobb. Men det er en variert, aktiv og meningsfull jobb, stort sett på dagtid i ukedager.

Vil du ha en jobb der du faktisk gjør en forskjell - hver eneste vakt?

Vil du være ute, i bevegelse og en del av et sammensveiset team?

Da sender du søknad og CV til jobb@trafikkjentene.no (kun søknader med CV vil bli vurdert).

Vi tilbyr

💛 Hva får du hos oss?

  • Gode lønnsbetingelser

  • Midlertidig stilling med fleksibilitet

  • Muligheter for videre karriere for den rette

  • Et inkluderende og solid arbeidsmiljø

  • Vi dekker nødvendige kurs for aktuelle kandidater

Stillingen passer for alle aldre, så lenge du har energien, ansvaret og motivasjonen.

Vi ønsker oss flere jenter i anleggsbransjen og oppfordrer spesielt jenter til å søke denne gangen!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Trafikkjentene AS ble startet i 2011 av Cecilie Vik, som så behovet for flere jenter i anleggsbransjen. Det som startet med manuell trafikkdirigering har vokst til å omfatte alt innen arbeidsvarsling, vedtak, skiltning og sikring.

Vi er i dag rundt 75 ansatte med base på Brobekk i Oslo. Kundene våre er hovedsakelig innen bygg- og anlegg, men vi jobber også mot kultur- og filmbransjen, kjøpesentre, trikk, lift- og stillasarbeid -- og mye mer.

Vi samarbeider tett med Granlund kompetansesenter for å sikre høy kvalitet og riktige sertifiseringer innen arbeid på og ved vei.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
At Tive, we imagine a fully-transparent world in which everything and everyone is connected. We innovate beyond what the world thought possible - so what people hold near and dear arrives on time and in full.

We believe (and live!) four core values:

  • Transparency First: We make everything visible so that everyone can operate better

  • Always strive to make things simpler

  • We are One Team, we have each other's backs

  • Relentless iteration to optimize and improve

Whether shipped by road, rail, ocean, or air, Tive reduces shipment delays, minimizes rejected loads, and decreases theft, damage, and spoilage. Our customers count on Tive to ensure that their shipments are delivered on time and in full - because every shipment matters.

As a Senior Software Engineer at Tive, you will be a key part of our full-stack team in Mo i Rana. We are building a large-scale data platform that gives global customers real-time visibility into their supply chains. You'll have the freedom to be a strong individual contributor while helping the team reach our goal: turning massive amounts of data into predictable insights for shipments worldwide.

Our ideal candidate has:

  • Solid Experience: 5+ years in software engineering. You're experienced and know how to build stable, multi-tier web applications.

  • The Right Tools: You are comfortable with C# and have a good handle on databases like SQL Server or Postgres.

  • A Broad Perspective: You understand the full stack, from the front-end to the back-end services that keep everything running.

  • Curiosity for the Modern Stack: If you have experience with AWS or streaming data (Kinesis/Kafka), that's a big plus, but a desire to learn and share your knowledge is just as important.

  • A Collaborative Spirit: You enjoy working with others. To us, "Senior" means you are someone your teammates can lean on for advice and a helping hand.

What you'll be doing:

  • Building the Core: You'll work on all parts of the development lifecycle: Coding, testing, and maintaining the APIs and web applications our customers rely on.

  • Sharing Knowledge: You'll lead by example. This means doing code reviews and pair programming to help everyone improve.

  • Connecting the Dots: You'll work closely with colleagues both in the office and remotely across different time zones. We value clear communication and looking out for one another.

  • Developing Tive: You'll contribute to an environment where we constantly iterate to improve our products and make our office a great place to work.

Why Mo i Rana?

  • A Hub for Innovation: Join a growing tech community in a city that is becoming a center for green industry and digital development.

  • The Best of Both Worlds: Enjoy the benefits of a global tech company without the "big city" stress. You're minutes away from the mountains, the fjord, and world-class hiking or skiing.

  • Short Commutes, More Life:Forget sitting in traffic. In Mo i Rana, you get your afternoons back, allowing for a genuine work-life balance.

What does Tive offer?

  • A chance to join what may very well turn out to be the most important company in your career.

  • The autonomy and resources to build what you know how to build.

  • Work with a committed global team that have each others back.

  • Office-based or hybrid options. Your choice.

  • Competitive equity to ensure all of our employees have a sense of ownership in the long-term success of Tive's growth.

title: Sjåfør
description:
Vi i DSV setter ambisiøse mål og bygger et miljø preget av samarbeid, ansvarlighet og handling. Med over 160 000 kollegaer i mer enn 90 land jobber vi hver dag for å forme fremtidens logistikk. Vi ser positivt på mangfold og har en sterk lagånd og fellesskap. Ønsker du å være med på vårt videre arbeid - er du hjertelig velkommen til å sende inn din søknad!

Som kjørende servicemedarbeider / sjåfør får du spennende utfordringer så vel som personlig og faglig utvikling - med utgangspunkt i vår felles motivasjon og din erfaring bak rattet. Vi søker deg som trives i en aktiv arbeidshverdag og som kan jobbe med varedistribusjon effektivt og trygt. Det er viktig at du kommuniserer godt på norsk og bygger gode relasjoner.

  • Lasting og lossing av varer

  • Fokus på trygg og sikker kjøring og varetransport

  • Yte service overfor våre kunder  Kompetanse• Førerkort kl C (godkjent YSK og ADR)

  • Erfaring med varelevering/sjåførarbeid 

Vi tilbyr:

  • En ny og moderne bilpark 

  • Hos oss i DSV vil du møte ryddige forhold og forutsigbarhet i forhold til lønns- og arbeidsvilkår

  • Bedriftshelsetjenesteordning

For mer informasjon, kontakt Lone Enge enten på telefon 40301885 eller e-post lone.enge@dsv.com

Om arbeidsgiveren:

DSV -- Global transport and logistics

Working at DSV means playing in a different league.

Som en global markedsleder innen transport og logistikk har vi hatt en imponerende vekstreise -- og vi er langt fra ferdige. Nå inviterer vi deg til å vokse sammen med oss mens vi fortsetter å innovere, digitalisere og bygge videre på våre suksesser. Med nesten 160 000 kolleger i over 90 land jobber vi hver dag for å levere solide tjenester, møte kundenes behov og hjelpe dem med å nå sine mål. Vi vet at nøkkelen til suksess ligger i nye talenter, friske perspektiver og ambisiøse mennesker -- akkurat som deg.

title: Camper & Car Mechanic
description:
Arctic Campers AS is looking for a skilled mechanic to join our workshop team in Tromsø. We are looking for a hands-on, reliable, and positive team player who enjoys working on both vehicles and camper van systems.

The role includes servicing and repairing cars and camper vans, as well as maintaining and repairing camper conversions, including electrical systems, water systems, heating systems, furniture, and other camper equipment.

We are looking for a full-time employee with the possibility of long-term employment.

Educational and Skill Requirements

  • Qualified car mechanic (vocational education or equivalent)

  • Experience as a car mechanic

  • Experience with camper vans or recreational vehicles is an advantage

  • Good command of English

  • Valid Category B driver's license (BE license is an advantage)

  • Independent and quality-focused working style

  • Positive attitude, honesty, and ability to work well in a team

Main Responsibilities

  • Service, maintenance, and repair of cars and camper vans

  • Diagnostics and troubleshooting of mechanical and electrical faults

  • Maintenance and repair of camper van conversion systems

  • Installation and repair of camper equipment and accessories

  • Tire changes, including mounting and balancing tires both on and off rims

  • Preparing vehicles for rental

  • Quality inspections before and after rentals

  • Other workshop-related tasks as required

Working Hours

You will work 5 days per week , with 7.5 working hours per day and a 30-minute unpaid lunch break.

Working Permit

Arctic Campers AS welcomes applications from both Norwegian residents and international candidates.

  • Norwegian citizens: No work permit is required.

  • EU/EEA citizens: We will assist with the necessary paperwork required to register and work legally in Norway.

  • Non-EU/EEA citizens: We do not sponsor work visas or residence permits. Applicants who require visa sponsorship are unfortunately not eligible for this position and should not apply.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Arctic Campers AS is Norway's largest camper van rental company, with locations in Tromsø and Oslo. We offer a wide range of custom-built camper vans, giving our guests the freedom to explore Norway's breathtaking landscapes at their own pace.

We are a young, dynamic, and international team made up of both locals and expats. We value teamwork, initiative, and a positive attitude, and we take pride in delivering outstanding service and unforgettable travel experiences.

Ulmo AS is an innovative Norwegian technology company developing sustainable solutions for water and wastewater systems, industry, fisheries, and the maritime sector. As part of our continued growth, we are looking for new colleagues who want to contribute to the next phase of Ulmo AS. Several European professionals are already part of our international team.

Ulmo AS is seeking an experienced Site Supervisor -- Water & Sewer Infrastructure to manage the daily execution of water and sewer infrastructure (VA) projects in Norway.

In this role, you will lead on-site project teams and ensure that work is completed safely, efficiently, and according to project specifications. You will work closely with project management and skilled technicians at various project locations throughout Norway.

This position is ideal for professionals who enjoy hands-on leadership, project responsibility, and working in dynamic infrastructure environments.

  • A high degree of autonomy and responsibility

  • Competitive Norwegian employment conditions and benefits

  • Opportunities for rotation schedules and flexible time-off arrangements

title: Data Engineer in Data Product Engineering
description:
If you choose to apply, please read the job ad in full and include a short cover letter. We are most interested in hearing from the real you, so we encourage authentic applications written in your own words.

The opportunity in a nutshell

Interested in combining hands-on data engineering with close collaboration across the business? This role could be a good fit for someone with 4+ years of experience who enjoys building reliable data products and working with others to make them useful.

Role: Join as a Data Engineer in our Data Product Engineering team within Schibsted's Data & AI organization, where we build reliable, well-governed, and scalable data products used across Finance, HR, Product, Subscription, and other parts of the business.

Core tools and practices: Our everyday toolkit includes SQL and Python as core languages, together with Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, AWS, Terraform, and Git, supported by solid engineering practices around testing, documentation, CI/CD, and version control.

Company: Schibsted is home to some of the most established and widely used media brands in the Nordics, including Aftenposten, VG, Svenska Dagbladet, Aftonbladet, E24, Bergens Tidende, and Stavanger Aftenblad. Across our broader Data & AI focus, data, analytics, and AI help us build better products, support smarter decisions, and create value across those newsrooms and businesses.

Location: This role is based in Oslo or Stockholm. We work in a hybrid setup, which means this is not a fully remote role, and candidates need to reside in Sweden or Norway and be able to work from one of our offices at least 2 days a week.

Why this role: You will join a relatively new team with room to contribute, learn, and help shape how we work as we continue to build trusted data products across Schibsted.

Sounds like your kind of role? Read onWho are you?

We are looking for someone with a solid foundation in data engineering who is also excited by the opportunity to keep learning, deepen their craft, and grow together with the team.

  • You have around 4+ years of experience in data engineering or a closely related role, with a track record of building reliable data solutions in production environments.

  • Strong SQL skills are important, along with a solid understanding of data modeling, data warehousing, and how to design data products that are useful, trustworthy, and maintainable.

  • You can write and debug SQL and Python yourself at a strong professional level. AI-assisted tools are welcome, but this role requires solid enough fundamentals to solve everyday engineering problems without depending totally on them.

  • On the Python side, we are looking for good software engineering fundamentals, including the ability to structure maintainable applications and apply object-oriented design principles where appropriate.

  • You have hands-on experience with dbt in production environments and solid working knowledge of the wider toolkit we use, including Airflow, Snowflake, AWS, Terraform, Git, and Python and / or similar tools.

  • You will likely enjoy this role if you are comfortable making pragmatic technical decisions in environments where requirements evolve and not everything is fully defined upfront.

  • You care about engineering quality and can contribute to practices around testing, documentation, observability, governance, and cost-efficient pipeline design.

  • Clear communication matters just as much as technical strength. We value people who can work well with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, explain tradeoffs clearly, and contribute positively to team collaboration and knowledge sharing.

What's the job like?

As a Data Engineer, your job is to help us build data as a product, not just pipelines that move data from one place to another. You will create robust data models, improve the reliability and scalability of our pipelines, and help shape the engineering practices that make our data products trusted and reusable across Schibsted Media.

What you will be expected to do

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business needs into pragmatic, well-scoped data solutions.

  • Design, build, and maintain reliable pipelines and transformations in Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, and Python.

  • Develop scalable data models that support analytics, reporting, and future AI use cases.

  • Improve technical quality through testing, documentation, monitoring, and maintainable engineering practices.

  • Contribute to good architectural and implementation decisions across the team.

  • Contribute through code reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing within the team.

  • Work closely with adjacent platform and Data & AI teams to align on standards, dependencies, and shared ways of working.

What success looks like

Success in this role means growing into a confident contributor who understands our data landscape, ways of working, and stakeholder needs. Over time, that includes contributing across a mix of smaller support tasks through our weekly rotation as well as larger pieces of work, helping build reliable pipelines and data models, and developing the judgment to deliver pragmatic solutions together with the team. Depending on your experience and the needs of the work, that can mean contributing as part of a team or taking the lead on a project.

Why join us?

  • You will join a team that is still shaping its ways of working, which means there is real room to contribute, learn, and grow.

  • You will work on data products with visible impact across Schibsted, supporting both technical and non-technical users in domains such as Product, Subscription, Finance, and HR.

  • You will be part of a company whose work matters in everyday life across the Nordics, helping support trusted media brands through better data, analytics, and AI capabilities.

  • You will work in an international environment with strong trust, autonomy, and good opportunities for learning through engineering communities and collaboration across Data & AI.

Got your attention? Let us hear from you!

The application period closes on 28 September 2026. We review applications on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

title: PhD Candidate in Laser-Induced Graphene (LIG) Sensors for Composite Materials
description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://youtu.be/Xt-yHCN5QS0About the position

We have a new vacancy for a 3-year PhD position at ASEMlab, NTNU Gjøvik, funded by Horizon Europe projects. The PhD candidate will work with NTNU's laser-induced graphene (LIG) sensing line developing a LIG sensor system for in-situ process monitoring of fibre reinforced composite systems, and maturing it from lab-scale prototypes to integration in demonstrators. The LIG system will be developed and benchmarked alongside complementary sensing technologies. This is a doctorate at the intersection of functional 2D materials, printed electronics, industrial composites manufacturing and structural health monitoring.

The position is hosted by ASEMlab – the Laboratory of Advanced and Sustainable Engineering Materials (www.asemlab.no) at the Department of Manufacturing and Civil Engineering, Faculty of Engineering, NTNU – Norwegian University of Science and Technology, Gjøvik campus. ASEMlab performs research on polymers and composite materials across their full life cycle: advanced manufacturing, structural health monitoring and sensing, non-destructive evaluation, durability and ageing, recycling and circularity, and sustainability assessment. The laboratory operates extensive infrastructure including manufacturing, sensor development, laser systems, thermal and physico-chemical analysis (DMA, TGA, FTIR, dielectric spectroscopy), mechanical and thermomechanical fatigue testing, accelerated ageing facilities, micro-CT, CMM, ultrasound imaging, etc.

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department.


Duties of the position
  • design and fabricate laser-induced graphene sensors and sensor arrays (temperature, strain, pressure) using ASEMlab's laser-processing infrastructure
  • characterise and calibrate the sensors electromechanically, structurally, thermally, morphologically, etc., using advanced analytical techniques, and benchmark them against complementary sensing technologies (e.g. fibre optics)
  • develop the LIG sensor system for process monitoring and structural health monitoring
  • implement the data-acquisition chain and data-import protocols as well as analyze sensor data for different needs 
  • Work closely with interdisciplinary teams of internal and external researchers specializing in sensor technologies, materials science, data analytics, etc.
  • analyze data and publish results in leading international journals and present at conferences, contribute to project deliverables, training workshops and dissemination activities

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme (link), see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in materials science/engineering, electronics/mechatronics, applied physics, nanotechnology, mechanical/manufacturing engineering or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis
  • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
  • demonstrated hands-on experience working in a research laboratory environment, including the safe handling of chemicals and operation of scientific instrumentation
  • strong foundational understanding of solid-state physics/chemistry and materials characterization techniques (such as Raman spectroscopy, SEM, or XRD)
  • hands-on experimental skills within sensors or functional/printed materials
  • very good written and oral English skills (documented per NTNU requirements for non-native speakers)
  • proven ability to work independently, manage a research project timeline, and collaborate effectively within a multidisciplinary team
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in English

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • experience in the design, fabrication, or characterization of electromechanical sensors, printed/flexible sensors, or graphene/2D and carbon-based functional materials 
  • hands-on experience with laser synthesis, laser micromachining, or optical systems, including CO₂ or UV laser platforms commonly used for LIG fabrication
  • experience with electronics prototyping, instrumentation and data acquisition tools (Python, LabVIEW), electrical characterization hardware (e.g., source meters, potentiostats, impedance analyzers) and basic signal processing, while interest in machine-learning-based process control is a plus
  • knowledge of fibre-reinforced polymer composites and their manufacturing processes
  • experience with electrical/electromechanical characterisation techniques (e.g. impedance spectroscopy, DIC-coupled strain sensing)
  • willingness to travel for test and demonstration campaigns for project needs in Europe 

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Work independently
  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Get involved and contribute constructively with feedback
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity 
  • Show curiosity and a strong motivation for the subject
  • Analyze data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions 
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed
  • proactive, self-driven, structured and rigorous in experimental work
  • collaborative and team-oriented mindset suited to a university lab and a large industrial consortium with firm deadlines
  • strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • curiosity and ambition to publish at a high international level

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer

Evaluate and remove/add what is relevant for the position.

  • An exciting job with an important mission in an international, EU-funded project consortium
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. 


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 550 800,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years for the doctoral work.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering Science Doctoral Programme - PhD - Faculty of Engineering Science - NTNU within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

The position is conditional on external funding.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The engagement is to be made in accordance with the regulations in force concerning State Employees and Civil Servants, and the acts relating to Control of the Export of Strategic Goods, Services and Technology. Candidates who, by assessment of the application and attachments, are seen to conflict with the criteria in the latter law will be prohibited from recruitment to NTNU.

Please note that the candidate holding the announced position is expected to work with critical infrastructure and areas subject to controls on the export of strategic goods, services and technology. Candidates with the potential of not fulfilling the requirements for security clearance, access clearance and authorization as described in the Act Relating to National Security, the Export Control Act and the Act on the Implementation of International Sanctions (Sanctions Act) cannot be considered for the position.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • CV and certificates/diplomas (BSc and MSc) with grade transcripts; diplomas in other languages must be accompanied by certified English translations
  • a motivation letter (max 2 pages) describing your suitability for and interest in the position
  • MSc thesis (or a draft if not yet completed) and any publications or other relevant research output
  • documentation of English language proficiency (e.g. IELTS/TOEFL) where applicable
  • names and contact details of at least two referees


If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.


Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Professor Sotirios Grammatikos, Director of ASEMlab, Department of Manufacturing and Civil Engineering, NTNU Gjøvik. E-mail: sotirios.grammatikos@ntnu.no

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Advisor Kristine Rognlid Hagaseth kristine.r.hagaseth@ntnu.no 

Application deadline: 11.09.2026

-----------------

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 
 

Gjøvik, a charming town by the shores of Lake Mjøsa, is known for its beautiful nature and rich cultural offerings. The town boasts a vibrant community with excellent schools, modern healthcare services, and a variety of recreational activities. With its strategic location, just a short drive from Oslo, Gjøvik combines the best of urban life and natural experiences. Here, you'll find a dynamic business environment and exciting career opportunities in a setting that values work-life balance.

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

The Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) creates knowledge for a better world and solutions that can change everyday life.
