title: Commercial Excellence Lead (m/f/d)
description:
Within the Eastern Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EEMEA). Commercial Operations & Strategy Organization, the Commercial Excellence Lead will elevate commercial excellence across the region, enable strong alignment across multiple functions and divisions, and lead commercial-capability readiness for our emerging launch pipeline in EEMEA. Strong, trusted partnership with cluster commercial operations teams is essential to the success of this role. Key stakeholders will be the EEMEA Leadership Team (LT), HHI Commercial Operations, regional Chief Marketing Officers (CMO) & Regional Commercial Leads (RCL), and market Commercial Operations Directors (CODs.)
This is a Band 400 individual-contributor role. The primary location is Switzerland, with secondary locations in the Europe or Middle East time zones may be considered upon further discussion with the hiring manager. The role includes approximately 25% travel within Eastern Europe, Middle East, and Africa.
Responsibilities:
Commercial Capabilities:  Drive customer engagement evolution in partnership with Digital Engagement teams, ensuring commercial capabilities, segmentation, omnichannel execution and customer insights are translated into improved customer experience and business outcomes.
Relevant focus areas include:
•    Sales Force Effectiveness: Ensure proper Sales Incentive Plan (SIP), target setting, CRM operations and upgrades, and Sales Force of the Future (SFOF) deployment in select markets.  Ensure an ongoing focus on segmentation and targeting and Multichannel Cycle Plans (MCCP) efforts in the region.  Leverage data, analytics and business insights to improve sales force effectiveness in the region.
•    Key Account Management:  Ensure the roll out of Key Account Management and Top Customer programs in the region. Ensure successful capability roll-out and work with Market Access and Franchises to increase access at account level.
•    Commercial Trade Channels: Align with HHI on new capability roll-out and support markets in uncovering Commercial Trade Channel (CTC) opportunities.
Operational Governance & Execution:  Work with all relevant stakeholders to secure the EEMEA Commercial Operations & Strategy (CO&S) vision and business strategies and proactively identify and execute projects and programs of strategic importance to the region and our customers in a timely, effective, and efficient fashion. Be the communicator / connector / catalyst for cross-functional projects managed by extended regional stakeholders. Relevant focus areas include:
•    CO&S Governance: Manage all governance activities for the CO&S department, including setting the agenda for virtual and face-to-face meetings and periodic forum calls with market leads and other relevant stakeholders.
•    Business Impact Measurement: Establish measurement frameworks to evaluate the impact of commercial capability investments, ensuring visibility to adoption, effectiveness, customer outcomes and business value realization.
•    Continuous Improvement: Continue to identify opportunities to drive simplification and harmonization across the region in collaboration with CO&S stakeholders including Digital Human Health (DHH). Support markets and the region in Objective & Key Result (OKR) transformation projects where requested.  Bring external industry best practices and innovative approaches into the region to continuously elevate commercial excellence.
•    Marketing Capabilities: Partner with regional Learning & Development (L&D), CMOs, and RCLs to build and scale marketing capabilities with a focus on L3 next deployment and sustainment.
•    Regional Projects: Ensure the successful deployment of projects associated with regional initiatives, priorities, and experimentations.
Launch Excellence:  Lead commercial-capability readiness that carries our emerging pipeline to flawless launch execution across markets. Relevant focus areas include:
•    Launch Capability Readiness: Partner with RCLs and market teams to ensure markets have the appropriate Go to Market (G2M) planning, segmentation, targeting, field-force sizing, training, forecasting support, and launch playbooks are in place well ahead of launch.
•    Launch Framework & Tracking: Establish a repeatable EEMEA launch-excellence framework and toolkit, with launch tracking that gives leadership visibility to timelines, milestones and risks.
AI-Enabled Commercial Excellence:  Champion the responsible adoption of GenAI across commercial workflows — helping teams work faster and smarter while safeguarding compliance and quality — and explore opportunities to embed AI into sales, marketing, field-force and launch ways of working, in partnership with key stakeholders.
Talent Development:  Build & support commercial-operations talent and capability development across the region.
We are looking for a commercially minded leader with 10+ years across sales, marketing, commercial operations and launch readiness who has successfully deployed commercial excellence capabilities in a complex, multinational environment. Combines strategic thinking with execution discipline, excels at influencing without authority, and has a strong track record of leading change, building capabilities, and translating data and technology into measurable business outcomes.

title: Natural Hazards Mission Lead
description:
ETH Zurich is establishing the ETH Swiss GeoLab, a new interdisciplinary unit of ETH Zürich I Space. ETH Space will soon become one of few strategic centres of ETH Zurich, and encompasses overall five units.

The GeoLab is focused on Earth observation and its applications. The GeoLab uses satellite, airborne, ground-based and in-situ observations. To these diverse data sets it applies AI-driven analysis methods and high-performance computing to develop solutions for specific societal and economic challenges.

Located at the D4 Business Village in Root, close to Lucerne, ETH Swiss GeoLab works at the interface of research, technology development and practical application. In its first phase, the GeoLab is focusing on few selected high-impact application areas where Earth observation, geodata and AI-based analytics can create tangible value for Switzerland. The Natural Hazards Mission focuses initially on mass movements, including landslides and rockfalls, with the aim of improving early detection, monitoring, preparedness and decision support for Swiss practitioners, authorities and infrastructure stakeholders. It builds on stakeholder engagement, solution scoping and community-building activities already underway within GeoLab, including contributions from senior domain experts and partners in the Swiss natural hazards community.

The ETH Swiss GeoLab is led by Prof. Dr Verena Griess and Prof. Dr Thomas Zurbuchen, with Dr Felix Seidel as Managing Director, responsible for the day-to-day operations of this exciting activity. The GeoLab will grow into a project-based hub of around 100 experts over the coming years and will collaborate closely with other ETH units, the Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS), Swiss research institutions, public-sector stakeholders, natural hazard organisations, industry partners, start-ups and international stakeholders.

This position is offered as a fixed-term appointment for an initial period of two years, with the possibility of extension.

As Natural Hazards Mission Lead, you will lead the research and development portfolio, integration and delivery of GeoLab’s Natural Hazards Mission. Initially focused on landslides and rockfalls, and later expanding to other natural hazards, you will help define the mission vision, translate user needs into research and product requirements, and ensure that GeoLab activities create measurable value for Swiss practice and public decision-making. You will build on ongoing interchange with key stakeholders and solution-scoping activities already underway within GeoLab, and work closely with senior domain-relevant partners, technical teams and experts.

You will report to the Managing Director of ETH Swiss GeoLab and work closely with GeoLab’s Natural Hazards Community & Solutions Lead, other GeoLab mission teams, the Research Program Support team, and the Geo-Intelligence team and external partners. You will define priorities, milestones and decision points, lead mission delivery and will have the authority to prioritize, redirect, and pivot or pause activities within your research and development portfolio, the approved mission charter, budget and governance framework.

As part of your role, you will:

On behalf of the GeoLab leadership team, define an ambitious and coherent research and development portfolio for the Natural Hazards Mission, initially centred on landslides and rockfalls
Translate identified critical operational gaps into measurable outcomes that create value for practitioners, authorities and decision-makers
Engage with local, cantonal and federal authorities, infrastructure operators, practitioners, industry and expert communities, in coordination with GeoLab leadership and existing Natural Hazards community activities
Translate operational challenges into research, data, product and technical requirements
Establish measurable mission outcomes, roadmaps, assumptions and success criteria aligned with Swiss natural hazard needs and the overall GeoLab strategy; you will also track progress actively against these outcomes
Manage the delegated mission budget and define priorities, milestones, decision points and success criteria and track finances and successes in that framework, through regular reporting activities to GeoLab leadership and other stakeholders
Work with the Geo-Lab’s Intelligence team – the team deeply focused on AI and Earth  observation foundational models - and external performers to drive pilots, field validation, operational testing and integration into user workflows
Assess evidence and performance, and recommend continuation, redirection, scaling, pausing or termination of activities
Identify and mobilise strong ETH groups, research institutions, engineering and geology offices, remote-sensing companies, public agencies and implementation partners
Represent ETH Swiss GeoLab in Swiss natural hazard, scientific, policy and industry communities, in coordination with GeoLab leadership and existing Natural Hazards community activities
Communicate mission goals, progress, evidence and lessons learned to internal and external stakeholders
Guide and train students, researchers and external contributors where required and support the transfer of resulting capabilities into operational practice
In summary, you understand the needs of practitioners and decision-makers in the field of natural hazards and their relation to Earth observations from space and are motivated by the opportunity to translate research and technology into practical solutions with measurable impact.

Specifically, we are looking for someone with:

A Master’s or PhD degree (preferred) in natural hazards, geosciences, engineering, risk management or related fields
Several years of experience in natural hazard practice, applied research, public administration, consulting, engineering or industry, preferably but not necessarily in Switzerland
Strong expertise and understanding of natural hazards with demonstrated examples of dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Proven ability to identify important operational problems and translate them into actionable initiatives
With a track-record of successful collaborations in diverse teams and have demonstrated your excitement to not only do research but apply that research to the benefit of others.
Experience in mission, programme or applied R&D portfolio design
Strong project, portfolio and budget management skills with demonstrated examples of transparent reporting, dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Excellent stakeholder management skills across diverse public authorities, academia, industry and expert communities
The ability to work across disciplinary and organisational boundaries and to lead through influence
Strong judgement skills under uncertainty and the willingness to challenge established approaches constructively
Excellent communication and listening skills, and great presentation skills in various modalities
Excellent written and spoken English and German; French is an asset
You are mission-driven, entrepreneurial, a strong learner and comfortable working in a newly established and evolving organisation. You have a track-record of successful team participation and leadership and an excitement for hard and impactful work. You combine scientific credibility with pragmatic decision-making, economic awareness and a clear focus on adoption, operational relevance and measurable value. In doing so, you want to work on the best idea, not necessarily your best idea.

A rare opportunity to help build ETH Swiss GeoLab from its early phase and shape a new national initiative for Earth observation
A mission-driven role with high visibility and strong societal relevance
The opportunity to develop solutions for pressing natural hazard challenges in Switzerland, and with broad international impact through transferable methods and lessons learned
A workplace in Root/Lucerne, embedded in an active innovation ecosystem and closely connected to ETH Zurich
We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:

Your CV
Diplomas and work certificates
A short motivation statement outlining your interest in ETH Swiss GeoLab and the Natural Hazards Mission
A video (max 2 mins) about you and your motivation for this position
Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through the ETH Zurich online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.

Further information about ETH Swiss GeoLab can be found on our website. Questions regarding the position should be directed to Dr Felix Seidel, Managing Director ETH Swiss GeoLab, felix.seidel@eaps.ethz.ch.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Pflegewegweiser Shop is a startup within this scale\-up. We're building an e\-commerce business from the ground up. The setup. You question existing setups and processes, iterate on them, and make them better. If something is slow, manual, or "just grew that way," you challenge it.  
The shop. You help improve the shop experience, drive e\-commerce sales, and elevate the customer experience — your insights and improvement suggestions can be implemented quickly and directly to give our customers a better experience.  
The numbers. You analyze marketing and sales KPIs to find growth opportunities and efficiencies. Your analysis doesn't just go into a report — it directly influences our spending and budget allocations.

German and English \- both C1\+

An affinity for healthcare/homecare — or the curiosity to dive deep  
Why this role  
0 to 1, for real. You build the growth engine instead of waiting for someone else to.  
Direct line to leadership. You report to the Senior Growth Manager and work closely with the Chief Business Development Officer. Short paths, fast decisions, no bureaucracy. You learn fast, get direct feedback, and quickly gain ownership of your own topics and areas of responsibility.  
Impact you can see. Small, independent team; your tests land in the business immediately.  
Scale at your back. The pace and autonomy of a startup, backed by the resources of an international group — in one of the biggest growth markets there is: homecare and digital health.  
How we operate — non\-negotiable:  
"Insanely great" for families — delivered now  
Forget mere "satisfaction." We deliver support that makes caregivers feel seen, understood, and valued. Anticipate their needs and solve problems quickly. The standard is "insanely great," period. Anything less slows us down and fails our families.  
Speed is king — ruthless focus is key  
Velocity comes from focus. Eliminate distractions. Concentrate all effort on the \#1 critical objective until it's done, then move to the next. Decide what not to do and cut it ruthlessly. Being a mile wide and an inch deep is failure — move the needle now.  
Raise the bar — crush mediocrity  
Mediocrity kills speed, morale, and companies. Hunt it down and eliminate it. Good enough is never good enough. Demand top performance from yourself and everyone around you. Own your work, deliver excellence fast, and accept no excuses.  
The speed algorithm — question, delete, simplify, accelerate  
Build momentum by questioning every requirement: who asked, and why? Delete ruthlessly — parts, processes, bureaucracy. Simplify what remains. Accelerate cycle times relentlessly. "It can't be done" means "you haven't figured it out yet — go do it." Break bottlenecks, find shortcuts, remove friction.  
Act like owners — bold bets, fast action  
This is your company. Own the mission and the results. Take initiative, make bold bets that leapfrog progress, and act decisively. If you stumble, learn faster and go again. Bias for action is everything.  
The bottom line:  
We are building something vital at lightning speed. This requires intensity, focus, and a relentless drive to execute. If reading this makes you want to jump in and build faster, welcome to Pflegewegweiser!  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
Deutsch:  
Wer wir sind  
Pflegewegweiser, Teil der Entyre Group, ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Health\-Tech\-Scale\-ups in der Schweiz und den USA – 500\+ Mitarbeitende, Standorte von Zürich bis Boston und eine Mission, die wirklich zählt: Menschen zu helfen, selbstbestimmt zu Hause zu leben. Wir sorgen dafür, dass Familien für die Pflege ihrer Angehörigen entschädigt werden, und beliefern sie mit den Homecare\-Produkten, auf die sie sich täglich verlassen.  
Der Pflegewegweiser Shop ist ein Startup innerhalb dieses Scale\-ups. Wir bauen ein E\-Commerce\-Business von null auf. Das heisst: keine Alt\-Accounts, die du erbst, keine 40\-seitigen Mediapläne und kein Warten über drei Quartale, bis dein Test live geht. Du launchst es, du ownst es, du liest und interpretierst die Zahlen, und handelst entsprechend.  
Was du ownst  
Die Paid\-Engine. Du ownst Google Search, Shopping und PMax end\-to\-end – von Kampagnen über Assets bis Budget. Du führst das Merchant Center und den Shopping\-Feed, als wären sie deine – denn das sind sie: saubere Daten, gesunde Diagnostics, top gepflegte Feeds.  
Meta \& Creatives. Du planst, launchst und optimierst unsere Meta\-Kampagnen. Du treibst die Creatives, die sie füttern – Static und Video – von Inhouse\-Produktion bis zum Briefen und Steuern von Agenturen. Du weisst: Eine Gewinner\-Ad ist kein Glückstreffer, sondern eine Testing\-Pipeline.  
Funnels. Du baust Marketing\-Funnels entlang der gesamten Customer Journey und optimierst sie konsequent – vom ersten Klick bis zum Wiederkauf.  
Growth Sprints. Du designst Experimente, die neue Wachstumschancen jenseits der täglichen Optimierungen ermöglichen. Du findest die Wachstumsmöglichkeiten, die wir noch nicht kennen und erschlossen haben.  
Neue Bets. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Head of E\-Commerce neue Geschäftsmodelle, prüfst sie auf Herz und Nieren und machst sie besser – und erweiterst so, was der Shop sein kann.  
Das Setup. Du hinterfragst bestehende Setups und Prozesse, iterierst sie und machst sie besser. Ist etwas langsam, manuell oder «einfach so gewachsen», stellst du es infrage.  
Der Shop. Du hilfst mit, die Shop\-Experience zu verbessern, E\-Commerce\-Sales zu treiben und die Customer Experience auf ein neues Level zu heben – deine Insights und Verbesserungsvorschläge können und direkt umgesetzt werden, um unseren Kunden eine bessere Customer Experience zu ermöglichen.  
Die Zahlen. Du analysierst Marketing\- und Sales\-KPIs, um Wachstumschancen und Effizienzen zu finden. Deine Analyse geht nicht nur in einen Report – sie hat einen direkten Einfluss auf unser Spending und Budget Allocations.  
Was du mitbringst  
1–2 Jahre Marketing\-Erfahrung, bevorzugt in Start\-ups, Scale\-ups oder Agentur  
Hands\-on\-Erfahrung mit Paid\-Kampagnen auf Google Ads und Meta – du hast selbst Kampagnen aufgesetzt und optimiert, nicht nur ein Dashboard beobachtet  
Ein datengetriebenes Verständnis von Marketing\- und E\-Commerce\-KPIs – fit in Reportings und in der Lage, von Rohdaten zu einer belastbaren Empfehlung zu kommen  
Ownership ab Tag eins – du baust lieber den Prozess, als auf einen zu warten  
Einen Umgang mit Ambiguität und eine gesunde Balance zwischen Speed und Qualität  
C1\+ Deutsch und Englisch  
Pluspunkte  
Erfahrung mit Google Merchant Center und Shopping\-Feeds  
Vertrautheit mit Shopify oder einer vergleichbaren E\-Commerce\-Plattform  
Basic Creative\-Skills (Canva, CapCut, Figma, Video Production) und Erfahrung im Briefen von Kreativagenturen  
Kenntnisse in A/B\-Testing, CRO und Funnel\-Analytik  
Eine Affinität zu Healthcare/Homecare – oder die Neugier, tief einzutauchen  
Warum dieser Platz  
0\-to\-1, wirklich. Du baust die Growth\-Engine, anstatt auf andere zu warten.  
Direkte Leitung zur Führung. Du berichtest an den Senior Growth Manager und arbeitest eng mit der Chief Business Development Officer zusammen. Kurze W

Entdecke die Schweizer Pflegeabteilungen in Deinem eigenen Tempo! Ob für einige Monate, zur Überbrückung oder als Einstieg für einen langfristigen Neuanfang: Wir bieten Dir spannende Temporäreinsätze in renommierten Schweizer Spitälern, Kliniken und Pflegezentren (u. a. in den Regionen Zürich, Basel, Bern und Zentralschweiz).

- Maximale Flexibilität: Du bestimmst die Dauer und den Zeitraum Deines Einsatzes (z. B. 3 bis 12 Monate).
- Attraktive Vergütung: Überdurchschnittlicher Schweizer Stundenlohn inklusive Zulagen.

- Anerkennung & Begleitung: Vollständige Unterstützung bei der SRK-Anerkennung sowie eine persönliche Betreuung vor und während Deines Einsatzes.
- Moderne Standards: Pflege auf hohem Niveau, hervorragend ausgestattete Häuser und eine wertschätzende Teamkultur.

- Professionelle und ganztägige Pflege sowie Betreuung der Patientinnen und Patienten auf Deiner Fachabteilung.
- Selbstständige Umsetzung von verordneten medizintechnischen und therapeutischen Maßnahmen.
- Lückenlose, digitale Pflegedokumentation und aktive Teilnahme an Übergaben.
- Einbringen Deines Fachwissens und Deiner Routine in wechselnden, dynamischen Teams.

Das bringst Du mit

- Qualifikation: Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Gesundheits- und Krankenpfleger/in, Pflegefachfrau / Pflegefachmann (HF/FH) oder eine gleichwertige anerkannt Ausbildung.
- Berufserfahrung: Erste fundierte Berufserfahrung in der Akut- oder Langzeitpflege.
- Persönlichkeit: Anpassungsfähigkeit, Freude an neuen Herausforderungen und ein hohes Maß an Empathie.
- Sprache: Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mindestens Niveau B2/C1).

Nutze die Chance für Deine persönliche und berufliche Weiterentwicklung – mit den besten Bedingungen.

title: (Senior) Netzingenieur*in (gn) im Produktmanagement digitaler Netzzwilling (Produktmanager/in)
description:
Wir suchen nicht zwingend eine fertige Produktmanagerin und keinen fertigen Produktmanager. Wir suchen Netz-Know-how.

Darum geht es:

Wir bauen mit der gaia powergrids Modulsuite einen digitalen Zwilling des Stromnetzes: eine Plattform, die Verteilnetzbetreiber unter anderem bei der Anschlussprüfung und der Zielnetzplanung unterstützt – dort also, wo heute Excel, Erfahrungswerte und lange Wartezeiten für Anschlusskunden aufeinandertreffen.

Für die Weiterentwicklung dieser Modulsuite suchen wir eine Person, die Netzpraxis mitbringt und mit dem Produktmanagement die fachlichen Konzepte erstellt, validiert und das Anforderungsmanagement dafür übernimmt. Du weißt, wie ein Netz wirklich geplant, gerechnet und bewertet wird – und übersetzt dieses Wissen in ein Produkt, das Netzbetreiber täglich nutzen.

‍

Das sind deine Aufgaben:

- Federführung für die fachlichen Konzepte der neuen powergrids Module – von der ersten Idee über die Validierung mit Kund*innen bis zur abgestimmten Spezifikation.
- Fachliche Instanz für elektrotechnische und planerische Fragestellungen rund um das Produkt – du stellst sicher, dass unsere Verfahren dem Stand der Technik entsprechen und in der Praxis der Netzbetreiber tragen.
- Anforderungsmanagement: Anforderungen aus Kundenprojekten, Markt, Regulatorik und Datenanalysen strukturiert sammeln, schärfen und priorisieren.
- Übersetzen fachlicher Anforderungen in Konzepte, User Journeys und technische Spezifikationen – gemeinsam mit Engineering, Data Science und Design.
- Fachliche Bewertung von Netzmodellen, Netztopologien, Berechnungsverfahren, Datenflüssen und Schnittstellen – und Ableiten klarer Produktentscheidungen.
- Einbringen deiner Netzperspektive in Produktstrategie und Roadmap, gemeinsam mit Product Owner und Produktleitung.
- Enger Austausch mit Pilotkund*innen, Partner*innen sowie unseren Kolleg*innen aus Sales und Customer Success.

‍

Das bringst du mit:

- Abgeschlossenes technisches Studium – Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen mit energietechnischer Vertiefung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
- Praxiserfahrung bei oder für einen Verteilnetzbetreiber bzw. Energieversorger in einer technischen Rolle mit Stromnetzbezug – also auch, wenn du diese Erfahrung als Dienstleister*in, im Ingenieurbüro oder in der Beratung gesammelt hast.

Zum Beispiel als:

- Netzplaner*in oder Grundsatzplaner*in (Mittel- und/oder Niederspannung)
- Netzberechner*in
- Ingenieur*in im Netzanschluss- oder Kundenanschlussprozess
- Asset Manager*in
- Mitarbeiter*in in Netzbetrieb, Betriebsführung oder Netzführung
- Projektierer*in oder Ingenieur*in in Netzdokumentation / GIS
- Fundiertes technisches Netzverständnis: Du kennst das Stromnetz und seine Betriebsmittel im Detail. Lastfluss- und Kurzschlussberechnungen kannst du einordnen und interpretieren – oder du bringst die Grundlagen mit, um dich schnell darin einzuarbeiten.
- Idealerweise hast du selbst schon Anschlussprüfungen für neue Anlagen in mindestens einer Spannungsebene durchgeführt und/oder eine Zielnetzplanung erstellt.
- Ein Gespür dafür, welche technischen Fragen ein Netzbetreiber beantworten muss, bevor er einen Anschluss zusagt oder einen Netzausbau beschließt.
- Analytisches, datengetriebenes Denken und eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.
- Freude daran, Komplexität verständlich zu machen und Entscheidungen voranzutreiben.
- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse; gutes Englisch.

‍

Schön, wenn du es mitbringst – kein Muss

- Vertrautheit mit den einschlägigen Regelwerken zur Bewertung neuer Anschlussbegehren – in Deutschland z. B. VDE-AR-N 4100/4105/4110/4120 und die TAB, in der Schweiz die entsprechenden Werke von VSE und Netzbetreibern.
- Erfahrung mit Netzberechnungssoftware (z. B. PowerFactory, Integral, NEPLAN, pandapower, Sincal).
- Kenntnisse regulatorischer Rahmenbedingungen in Deutschland und/oder der Schweiz (z. B. Netzanschluss, Ausbauplanung, EEG/Redispatch, Anschlussbegehren-Prozesse).
- Verständnis von Schnittstellen und Systemlandschaften beim Netzbetreiber (GIS, ERP, Leitsystem).
- Erfahrung im Produktmanagement, mit agilen Methoden (Scrum, Kanban) oder in Softwareprojekten.
- Interesse/Know-how, wie KI, Simulationen und Datenmodelle in Softwareprodukte einfließen.
- Offene, positive Persönlichkeit, die den Austausch liebt und Freude an einem modernen, kooperativen Arbeitsumfeld hat.
- Exzellente Kommunikationsfähigkeiten – du kannst technische Zusammenhänge so erklären, dass Engineering, Design und Vertrieb sie gleichermaßen verstehen.
- Hohe Motivation, sinnvolle Entscheidungen voranzutreiben.
- Spaß an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit – von Engineering bis Sales.

‍

Auch wenn du noch nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst:

Vielleicht hast du noch nie eine Roadmap gepflegt, kein Backlog priorisiert und noch nie das Wort „User Journey" benutzt. Das ist in Ordnung. Wenn du in einer technischen Rolle beim Netzbetreiber gearbeitet hast, das Netz und seine Prozesse wirklich kennst und Lust hast, dein Wissen in ein digitales Produkt einzubringen statt in die nächste Anschlussprüfung im Einzelfall – dann bewirb dich. Wir bringen dir das Produkthandwerk bei; dein Netz-Know-how können wir nicht ersetzen.

Location: Romandie-Switzerland | Working model: Hybrid | Seniority: Senior | Language requirements: Very good written and spoken French and English

We are looking for an experienced Senior Security Engineer with strong expertise in Microsoft Security, Identity and/or Compliance and AI-enabled Modern Workplace or Cloud Services. The successful candidate will design, implement and deliver enterprise-scale security transformations across Microsoft 365, Azure and Microsoft Security technologies, helping customers strengthen their security posture while enabling productivity and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Security & Identity

- Design and implement enterprise security architectures aligned with Zero Trust principles.
- Lead customer engagements around Identity & Access Management, Identity Governance and Privileged Access Management.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, Passwordless Authentication, Identity Governance, Access Reviews, Lifecycle Workflows and Privileged Identity Management.
- Support hybrid identity transformations involving Active Directory, Entra ID and federated identity providers.

Cloud Security

- Design and deploy security solutions across Azure and Microsoft cloud environments.

- Conduct cloud security posture reviews and support customers in improving governance, policy management and secure workload design.
- Threat Protection & SOC Modernization

- Implement and tune Microsoft Sentinel including data onboarding, detection engineering, analytics rules, automation and SOAR use cases.
- Contribute to threat hunting, incident response readiness and security operations process improvement.

Data Security & Compliance

- Design and deploy Microsoft Purview solutions for information protection, sensitivity labels, data classification, DLP, records management and data lifecycle management.
- Support customers in meeting compliance, governance and data protection objectives.
- Translate regulatory and business requirements into practical security and compliance controls.

AI & Security Innovation

- Lead customer discussions around secure AI adoption and responsible use of Microsoft Copilot and Security Copilot.
- Deliver readiness assessments and governance frameworks for Copilot-enabled environments.
- Define controls to protect sensitive data and identities in AI-enabled collaboration and cloud scenarios.

Professional Experience

- Years of experience in enterprise security consulting, engineering or architecture.
- Proven experience delivering Microsoft security, identity, and/or compliance or cloud security projects.
- Experience working directly with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders.
- Strong consulting mindset with the ability to translate business requirements into pragmatic security solutions.
- Structured, self-reliant, solution-oriented working style with strong customer and team orientation.

Preferred Certifications

- SC-100 – Cybersecurity Architect Expert
- SC-300 – Identity and Access Administrator
- SC-200 – Security Operations Analyst
- SC-400 – Information Protection Administrator
- AZ-500 – Azure Security Engineer
- MS-102 – Microsoft 365 Administrator
- Additional Microsoft Security, Azure, Purview, Sentinel, Copilot or Security Copilot etc. certifications are a plus

title: Procurement and Contracts Officer - Switzerland
description:
What you'll do:
As part of the Industry, Procurement and Knowledge Transfer (IPT) Department, you will join the Procurement and Industrial Services Group (PI), which is responsible for procuring all supplies and services for the Organization, ensuring that the specified and contractual technical, delivery and performance requirements are met at the lowest possible overall cost whilst achieving balanced industrial returns for CERN Member States and respecting CERN's Procurement Rules. The Group monitors and reports procurement activities and statistics to CERN Management and Member State representatives.

Your responsibilities:
- Advise and support the Organization in identifying procurement strategies, ensuring cost efficiency and quality.
- Carry out research to identify and participate in the qualification of potential suppliers.
- Prepare price enquiries, market surveys and invitations to tender in accordance with the Organization's Procurement Rules and on an international basis.
- Analyse offers, prepare proposals for adjudications and submit these to CERN's Management.
- Ensure the preparation, negotiation and follow-up of numerous orders and contracts.
- Contribute to the advancement of CERN's procurement techniques and tools, influencing their modernisation and optimisation.
- Foster and sustain a wide-ranging network of relationships across diverse levels, both internally and externally, while actively representing CERN in global business events.

Your profile:
- Demonstrated experience in procurement of technical supplies or services with a strong understanding of source-to-contract processes and procurement systems.
- Experience in setting category or procurement project-level strategies.
- Experience in executing plans in a matrix-driven decision-making process.
- Experience in collaborating with diverse teams and senior stakeholders.
- Experience in public procurement and contract management is desired.
- Master's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Economics, Purchasing, Law, Engineering, or a related field.

Your skills:
- Definition of tendering and contracting strategies.
- Negotiating with external suppliers and service contract providers.
- Drafting of commercial documents for a supply or a service contract.
- Contract management: managing the commercial aspects of contracts, including the critical examination of offers and the handling of claims and disputes.
- Reviewing technical documents for a supply or a service contract.
- Delivers high quality work on time and fulfils expectations.
- Takes initiative beyond regular tasks and makes things happen.
- Utilises effective negotiation techniques to achieve long-term results acceptable to all parties involved.
- Identifies, defines and assesses problems, takes action to address them.
- Demonstrates a willingness to accept changing circumstances; supports initiatives for change.
- Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Good communication skills coupled with the ability to see trends and simplify complex information.
Track record in working within project timelines in a dynamic environment.

title: Senior Packaging Technician, Operations (m/f/d) - [R408196]
description:
The Senior Packaging Technician is responsible for independently executing clinical packaging activities in compliance with internal specifications, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), batch records and applicable Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP)/ Good Documentation Practice (GDP) and Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) requirements. This role performs primary and secondary packaging, operates packaging and labelling systems, supports documentation and SAP transactions, coordinates routine technical tasks within assigned studies and serves as an experienced technical point of contact for day-to-day packaging activities.  

Key Responsibilities:

1. Clinical Packaging Operations
•    Performs primary packaging of clinical studies according to internal specifications, SOPs and batch records.
•    Performs secondary packaging of clinical studies according to internal specifications, SOPs and batch records.
•    Supplies ordered study material to the corresponding packaging rooms and prepares materials in accordance with the relevant SOPs.
•    Operates packaging and labelling systems in support of clinical packaging activities.

2. Technical Coordination
•    Trains and supports new technicians during onboarding and routine operations.
•    Performs administrative work related to packaging orders and clinical packaging activities.
•    Escalates problems directly to the supervisor or manager as required.
•    Coordinates the execution of bottle filling, labelling and packaging activities for clinical studies.
•    Oversees compliance-related aspects of packaging orders and serves as a technical point of contact for technicians assigned to individual studies.
•    Performs cleaning verification for equipment and rooms and completes final cleaning verification at study closeout.
•    Executes SAP transactions related to packaging activities.
•    Prepares GMP documentation, including required photographs, and creates batch notes or comments as applicable.
•    Reviews and coordinates Packaging Technicians’ activities within the assigned area.
•    Supports the transfer of cold materials as required during daily operations.  
•    Ensures study completion and hands over completed studies to the supervisor.

3. Routine Operational Tasks
•    Performs or coordinates routine tasks such as scale adjustments, deionized water flushes, and replenishment of consumables to support operational readiness.  
•    Provides day-to-day operational support to ensure readiness of packaging rooms, equipment and materials.
•    Supports the Packaging Compliance Support team with batch pre- and post-execution reviews.  

4. Documentation & Systems
•    Assists in document preparation, control and process improvement for packaging activities.
•    Uses SAP, Word and Excel for documentation and operational support, including the accurate completion of electronic logs.

title: Agriculture Mission Lead – Earth Observation and Agricultural Decision Support
description:
ETH Zurich is establishing the ETH Swiss GeoLab, a new interdisciplinary unit of ETH Zürich I Space. ETH Space will soon become one of few strategic centres of ETH Zurich, and encompasses overall five units.

The GeoLab is focused on Earth observation and its applications. The GeoLab uses satellite, airborne, ground-based and in-situ observations. To these diverse data sets it applies AI-driven analysis methods and high-performance computing to develop solutions for specific societal and economic challenges.

Located at the D4 Business Village in Root, close to Lucerne, ETH Swiss GeoLab works at the interface of research, technology development and practical application. In its first phase, the GeoLab is focusing on few selected high-impact application areas where Earth observation, geodata and AI-based analytics can create tangible value for Switzerland. In agriculture, this includes challenges related to productivity, resilience, resource efficiency, environmental performance and decision support for practitioners and policymakers.

The ETH Swiss GeoLab is led by Prof. Dr Verena Griess and Prof. Dr Thomas Zurbuchen, with Dr Felix Seidel as Managing Director, responsible for the day-to-day operations of this exciting activity. The GeoLab will grow into a project-based hub of around 100 experts over the coming years and will collaborate closely with other ETH units, the Swiss national centre for supercomputing (CSCS), Swiss research institutions, public-sector stakeholders, agricultural organisations, industry partners, start-ups and international stakeholders.

This position is offered as a fixed-term appointment for an initial period of two years, with the possibility of extension.

As Agriculture Mission Lead, you will spearhead the agriculture focused initiative - the GeoLab Agriculture Mission - within GeoLab. You will identify high-impact challenges in Swiss agriculture through direct interchange with key stakeholders and rely on domain-relevant data and experts. Moreover, you will define ambitious mission outcomes, translate practitioner needs into research and product goals, and drive solutions through field validation and adoption.

You will work closely with other GeoLab mission teams, its Research Program Support team, and the Geo-Intelligence team (plus the external partners mentioned above). You will lead cross-functional and external experts and will have the authority to prioritize, redirect, and pivot or pause activities within the approved mission charter, budget and governance framework.

As part of your role, you will:

On behalf of the GeoLab leadership team, define an ambitious and coherent Agriculture Mission addressing major opportunities in productivity, resilience, resource efficiency and environmental performance
Identify operational gaps where ETH Swiss GeoLab can create distinctive value for Swiss agriculture
Engage directly with farmers, agricultural advisory services, producer organisations, cooperatives, cantonal and federal authorities, insurers, technology providers and industry partners
Identify unmet needs, operational constraints, incentives and economic drivers in agricultural practice
Translate agricultural challenges into clear research, data, product and technical requirements
Assess user value, economic viability, scalability and adoption potential
Establish measurable mission outcomes, roadmaps, assumptions and success criteria aligned with Swiss agricultural needs and the overall GeoLab strategy; you will also track progress actively against these outcomes
Manage the delegated mission budget and define priorities, milestones and decision points and track finances and successes in that framework, through regular reporting activities to GeoLab leadership and other stakeholders
Work with GeoLab’s Geo-Intelligence team – the team deeply focused on AI and analyses of big data amounts - and external performers to drive field pilots, validation, operational testing and integration into agricultural workflows
Identify and mobilise strong research groups, agricultural organisations, technology companies, start-ups, service providers, insurers, public agencies and implementation partners
Represent ETH Swiss GeoLab within Swiss agricultural, scientific, policy and innovation communities
Communicate mission goals, progress, evidence and lessons learned at field events, workshops and conferences
Guide and train students, researchers and external contributors where required and support knowledge transfer into agricultural practice.
In summary, you understand the realities of agricultural practice and are motivated by the opportunity to translate research, Earth observation data and data-driven technologies into practical solutions with measurable impact.

Specifically, we are looking for someone with:

A Master’s or PhD degree (preferred) in agricultural sciences, agronomy, crop science, agricultural engineering, environmental sciences or related fields
Several years of experience applied research, program delivery or operational implementation, in agricultural practice, advisory services, agri-technology, public administration or industry, preferably but not necessarily in Switzerland

title: Head of Geospatial AI - Foundation Models and Geo-Intelligence Platform
description:
ETH Zurich is establishing the ETH Swiss GeoLab, a new interdisciplinary unit of ETH Zürich I Space. ETH Space will soon become one of few strategic centres of ETH Zurich, and encompasses overall five units.

The GeoLab is focused on Earth observation and its applications. The GeoLab uses satellite, airborne, ground-based and in-situ observations. To these diverse data sets it applies AI-driven analysis methods and high-performance computing to develop solutions for specific societal and economic challenges.

Located at the D4 Business Village in Root, close to Lucerne, ETH Swiss GeoLab works at the interface of research, technology development and practical application. In its first phase, the GeoLab is focusing on few selected high-impact application areas where Earth observation, geodata and AI-based analytics can create tangible value for Switzerland,  in areas such as natural hazards, agriculture, and forestry.

The ETH Swiss GeoLab is led by Prof. Dr Verena Griess and Prof. Dr Thomas Zurbuchen, with Dr Felix Seidel as Managing Director, responsible for the day-to-day operations of this exciting activity. The GeoLab will grow into a project-based hub of around 100 experts over the coming years and will collaborate closely with other ETH units, the Swiss national centre for supercomputing (CSCS), Swiss research institutions, public-sector stakeholders, agricultural organisations, industry partners, start-ups and international stakeholders.

This position is offered as a fixed-term appointment for an initial period of two years, with the possibility of extension.

As Head of Geospatial AI, you will spearhead the Geo-Intelligence Team and own the development and implementation of ETH Swiss GeoLab’s geospatial AI, data and shared platform capabilities. With domain experts from academia and the tech industry, you will help define the technical strategy and architecture for multimodal foundation models, agentic AI systems, geospatial tools, data pipelines and compute infrastructure.

You will work closely with Research Program Support teams (plus the external partners mentioned above). You will lead cross-functional and external experts and will have the authority to prioritize, redirect, and pivot or pause activities within the approved mission charter, budget and governance framework.

As part of your role, you will:

On behalf of the GeoLab leadership team, define and implement ETH Swiss GeoLab’s geospatial AI and technical strategy
Based on broad inputs, establish the target architecture for multimodal foundation models, agentic systems, geospatial data pipelines, compute environments and the shared Geo-Intelligence Platform
Adopt or set technical standards, priorities, interfaces and development principles aligned with GeoLab strategy and mission requirements
Drive and lead the design, development, evaluation and operationalisation of multimodal geospatial foundation models and related agentic capabilities
Encourage, enable or direct prototyping, benchmarking, validation and integration activities
Ensure that technical work produces reliable, reusable and operationally relevant capabilities rather than isolated research demonstrators
Own and be empowered to adapt the technical roadmap and delivery of the shared Geo-Intelligence Platform, including data access, processing pipelines, model-training environments, deployment capabilities and integration with HPC and cloud infrastructure
Coordinate with CSCS, ETH units, innovation leaders and technology providers to ensure scalability, security, efficiency and maintainability
Work with the Natural Hazards, Agriculture, Forestry and future Mission Leads to translate mission requirements into technical capabilities and delivery plans
Assess feasibility, define technical milestones, allocate technical resources and resolve trade-offs between mission-specific development and reusable platform components
Redirect technical work when evidence, performance or mission priorities require it
Lead or support technical collaborations with ETH groups, research institutions, CSCS, hyperscalers, companies, start-ups and open-source communities
Structure joint development activities, evaluate external capabilities and mobilise partners where they can accelerate delivery or provide distinctive expertise
In summary, you have a track record of innovative thought-leadership and a track record in brining others along with you on a journey for which the goal may not be 100% clear at the beginning. You are a voracious learner and are able to translate ambitious scientific and operational needs into robust, scalable and reusable technical solutions.

Specifically, we are looking for someone with:

A Master’s or PhD degree in computer science, machine learning, geo-informatics, engineering, remote sensing or a related field
Several years of experience leading technical AI/ML, geospatial data or large-scale software and platform development activities that includes interactions with user communities
Demonstrated experience defining technical architectures, guiding interdisciplinary teams and managing technical resources such as platform architectures and large-scale data processing and ML workflows
Strong expertise in machine learning and multimodal foundation models with a track record of learning and adaptability as the industry and technological tools change. This also involves experience with agentic AI, reasoning systems or related AI architectures.
Excellent understanding of geospatial AI, Earth observation and remote sensing
Experience with HPC, cloud infrastructure or distributed computing environments
Proven ability to build reliable, reusable and operational technical capabilities in a cost-effective and agile manner
Experience working with academic, infrastructure, technology or industry partners
Excellent written and spoken English; German or French is an asset
You bring strong technical judgement and the ability to set direction under uncertainty. You have an excitement for technology and a passion to use this technology to enable breakthrough research and to change lives through the results it produces. You are a fast learner and a strong listener who also has the courage to try things and pivot where expectations are not fulfilled. You are able to lead highly qualified specialists, resolve architectural trade-offs and translate mission needs into scalable technical solutions. You are structured, delivery-oriented and willing to challenge or redirect weak approaches where needed. You communicate effectively across scientific, engineering, management and industry environments and build trust while maintaining clear standards, accountability and focus on outcomes.

The great and rare opportunity to help build ETH Swiss GeoLab from its early phase and shape a new national competence centre for Earth observation
A senior technical leadership role with high visibility and strategic relevance
The opportunity to develop geospatial AI capabilities with direct application to societal, environmental and economic challenges
The opportunity to build novel and useful AI, data and platform capabilities for multiple mission areas
A workplace in Root/Lucerne, embedded in an active innovation ecosystem and closely connected to ETH Zurich
We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:

Your CV
Diplomas and work certificates
A short motivation statement outlining your interest in ETH Swiss GeoLab and the Agriculture Mission
A video (max 2 mins) about you and your motivation for this position.
Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through the ETH Zurich online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.

Further information about ETH Swiss GeoLab can be found on our website. Questions regarding the position should be directed to Dr Felix Seidel, Managing Director ETH Swiss GeoLab, at felix.seidel@eaps.ethz.ch.

title: IBU Access & Value Lead - Orexin Franchise
description:

- Communication: Ability to communicate effectively and influence diverse global and Local stakeholders with strong interpersonal and influencing skills in a multicultural, international environment and proven ability to build alignment.

title: Gasoline Blending Operator #R-018360#
employer: TRAFIGURA PTE LTD, Singapour,succursale de Genève
description:
Main purpose
Responsible for execution of Gasoline Blending operations and trader support. The role co-ordinates all aspects of post-deal trading activity to ensure contract execution runs efficiently, provides commercial and market information to the trader as necessary, and reviews and comments on contracts and tenders to ensure consistency with the trade ticket and recap.

Key responsibilities
For all Gasoline blended cargoes, be the key point of contact between the commercial desk and external stakeholders.
Liaise with terminals and vessels to ensure commercial blending plans are followed in line with the traders’ expectations.
Ensure with inspection companies that quality is as per blend plans and in line with contractual provisions.
Investigate Quantity losses and explore remedial action.
Trouble shoot when plans change and provide solutions.
Actively manage the terminals line up to mitigate demurrage.
Review stowage plans and monitor vessel progress during voyages.
Appoint third-party providers in line with group policy; oversee clean acceptance of vessels on subjects and chartering progress.
Liaise and co-ordinate with Finance, providing accurate and timely data needed for the issuance of L/Cs and P/Us.
Issue documentary instructions to suppliers and handle all aspects of customs exportation/importation where applicable.
Maintain good contract and shipping files electronically; keep Pluto updated regularly and minimise exceptions.
Complete voyage and storage reconciliations to identify and investigate loss/gain differences for each operation.
Monitor and advise the deals desk of all costs related to each transaction, maintaining P&L awareness.
Ensure operations are optimised to best commercial advantage, meeting all contractual obligations (e.g. minimising demurrage exposure).
Maximise recoveries; document, present and secure payment of all claims to third parties.
Maintain strong working relationships with trade support divisions — claims, deals desk, trade finance and chartering — and with counterparts and third-party service providers.
Train and develop less experienced members of the operations team to increase knowledge and commercial awareness.
Follow internal procedures and company policies; adhere to Trafigura's Code of Conduct, HSEC Policy and Business Principles.
Identify operational issues and escalate to the Regional Manager as appropriate.

Required qualifications
At least 5 years' experience in cargo operations in a global oil trading company.
Experience working on Gasoline cargo operations with a preference for experience with blending operations.
Ability to interpret the operational requirements of contracts and comment on operational aspects; understanding of the basic legal framework supporting oil contracts.
Ability to interpret charter party terms against the interacting oil contract; good understanding of common ship operations and terminology.
Good understanding of relevant petroleum product specifications, analytical methods, laboratory precision and inspection procedures.
Good understanding of different types of financial instruments, their uses, and the importance of LOIs and shipping documents within the trading process.

Preferred qualifications
Experience across multiple product desks (Gasoline, Distillates and Fuel Oil).
Familiarity with Pluto or similar trade operations management systems.
Exposure to storage logistics and reconciliation processes.

Attributes for success
Strong decision-making ability — comfortable navigating ambiguity and complexity in a fast-moving trading environment.
Effective networker who builds and maintains relationships with counterparts, service providers and internal stakeholders.
Organised and detail-oriented, with strong planning and prioritisation skills.
Resourceful and commercially aware, with a proactive approach to problem-solving.

Department overview
The Oil Cargo Operations department is responsible for the efficient and effective management of the physical movement of oil and petroleum products. The team ensures commodities are transported from origin to destination, meeting all contractual obligations and regulatory requirements. The department works closely with Traders, Finance, Deals Desk (Risk and P&L) and Chartering to support the full trade lifecycle.

  *  Develops and continuously optimizes performance-based rating systems as the foundation for sales conditions and services provided by VAT.
  *  Monitor channel partner performance and, together with local Channel Partner and ADV Sales Leaders, decide on onboarding new channel partner or phasing out underperforming channel partner.
  *  Supports Regional Sales Channel Managers with standardized analysis tools and templates to monitor channel partner performance and conduct business reviews efficiently.
  *  Support the regional Sales Channel Manager in organizing channel partner meetings.


Digital Sales Channels

  *  Develop the ADV digital customer journey in close collaboration with the data architects to automatize transactional tasks and enhance productivity.
  *  Support channel partners with digital tools and services.
  *  Establish digital customer services in collaboration with other Business Units.


Go-to-Market Strategy:

  *  Develop and execute the annual update of the Go-to-Market Strategy.
  *  Align and reinforce market reach strategy with ADV Sales Leaders and BU Management Team.
  *  Conduct regular reviews with ADV Sales Leaders to monitor progress and implement corrective actions where necessary.


Pricing Strategy:

  *  Support the ADV PM Pricing Team in pricing initiatives and implementation.
  *  Lead sales communication for the annual price adjustment.


Qualifications:

  *  Bachelor's degree in sciences, engineering or economy.
  *  Master in Business Administration.
  *  Fluent business English skills written and spoken.
  *  4+ years working experience in B2B Sales, Account Management or Channel Management.
  *  Vacuum market experience preferred.
  *  Solid experience in managing international projects.
  *  Strong entrepreneurial mindset combined with strategic clarity to identify and capture growth opportunities.
  *  Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives at global scale, spanning processes and systems.
  *  Executive-level communication skills, with the ability to influence customers, partners, and senior stakeholders.
  *  High level of ownership: self-driven, decisive, and accountable for outcomes.
  *  International mindset with strong cultural agility and a track record of building trust across regions.

title: Senior Consultant - Assurance - Technology Risk
description:
At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence.  
We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.  
Senior Consultant \- Assurance \- Technology Risk  
The opportunity  
Our Consulting business offers a broad range of functional and cross\-country services dedicated to providing high\-value and trusted advice to clients, with a specific focus on business transformation programs.

title: Supervisor Engine Shop Floor 100%
description:
We are a world leading Engine MRO service provider, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, with over 90 years of operational experience. Our unwavering dedication to innovation, excellence and environmental responsibility propels us forward on our journey to becoming the leading, most customer-centric, and sustainable Engine focused MRO worldwide.

Working with an extensive network of partners and business development offices in Europe, the USA, Asia and the Middle East, we offer comprehensive, fully customized solutions for the Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul of aircraft engines, airframes and components sales business including impeccable technical support to over 500 customers worldwide. Our mission: We safely power your flight.

We are looking for dedicated and skilled individuals to join our shop floor across several areas and departments at Zurich-Airport. If this sounds appealing to you, we encourage you to apply for our Supervisor position.

As a Supervisor Engine Shop Floor you will be responsible for the development and management of a highly effective Team of approximately 20 to 25 employees, striving for safety and quality, while delivering in time and on cost expectations. You will coordinate the team’s work with its direct stakeholders at SR Technics to the goals and missions of the organization.

Supervisor Engine Shop Floor 100%

Your tasks

- Promote a positive Safety Culture and ensure that Safety and Quality Policy are communicated/promoted and implemented within the Organization.
- Lead and manage a multi-cultural team, fostering performance, engagement, and a positive work environment.
- Drive performance culture through periodic target setting and regular structured follow up with all employees. Apply performance management process (PMP) and leadership with a focus on employee motivation.
- Plan and allocate resources to ensure high productivity and monitor labor efficiency
- Drive personnel development and skill management to meet capacity requirements (OJT, qualifications, certifications, performance evaluations).
- Execute and promote Continuous Improvements in applying Lean principles and 5S to achieve the organization targets and key performance indicators (KPI).
- Participate in, prepare for and be responsible for internal and external audits

Your Profile

- Technical background or technical education (aviation experience is a plus)
- Leadership experience with strong interpersonal skills and leadership skills with the ability to lead, motivate, and develop teams. Minimum 3 years team leadership or strong project leadership preferred.
- Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment and strong focus on safety, quality, and cost efficiency
- Proactive, independent, and self-initiated working style with high performance drive
- Knowledge and experience in applying Lean/Six Sigma methodology
- Proficient in English (B2+), German is an advantage
- Proficiency with maintenance documentation systems. Microsoft Office required, SAP is an advantage

title: Expert Clinical Trial Documentation - Clinical Trial Associate
description:
Expert Clinical Trial Documentation \- Clinical Trial Associate (CTA)  
Become part of a vital chain and contribute to our common goal of making people’s lives better. Headquartered in Lachen, Switzerland, Octapharma is one of the largest human protein manufacturers in the world, developing and producing medicines sourced from human plasma and human cell lines. We are a privately\-owned company, where the warmth of family meets the scale of a global organisation.  
Join us in shaping our vision to provide new health solutions advancing human life.  
Expert Clinical Trial Documentation \- Clinical Trial Associate (CTA)  
Your main tasks and responsibilities  
Set up and maintain Trial Master Files (TMFs) and lnvestigator Site Files (ISFs) according to Octapharma SOPs  
Support the Clinical Team in preparing clinical trial documents and documentation for regulatory submissions  
Track clinical trial documents such as insurance certificates, confidentiality agreements and study contracts throughout the trial lifecycle  
Maintain audit and inspection readiness through periodic review of TMF accuracy and completeness, quality control checks, and a unified TMF management approach. Support audits and inspection preparation and execution with regards to the TMF  
Act as a central contact for trial documentation, designated project communications, support ad hoc tasks  
Manage returning/archiving of TMF documents  
Assist in the organization of lnvestigator Meetings  
Perform various administrative tasks to support team members with clinical trial execution, as required (e.g. literature search or document formatting review for regulatory submissions)  
In addition, for the senior position:  
Assume Data Protection / Information Security Champion responsibilities  
Assists in development of SOPs  
Perform vendor evaluation and oversight for selected vendors  
Your expertise and ideal skill set  
A minimum of 1 year of experience as a CTA/documentation expert in international clinical trials or similar (3 years for the senior position)  
Fluent in both written and spoken English; preferably also in German  
Experience with various CTMS and TMF systems  
Excellent command of Microsoft Office applications and Adobe Acrobat DC  
Able to prioritize workload with attention to details and within timelines  
Able to learn on the job and apply new knowledge to future challenges  
Able to manage multiple and various tasks with a positive and flexible attitude  
Strong operational, organizational, documentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, able to work in a team and independently  
Your department \- where you make an impact  
The Clinical Research and Development (CR\&D) team in Lachen develops medicines that target complex and life\-threatening conditions in Haematology and Critical Care  
We specialize in clinical development of new as well as already marketed products  
The successful candidate will work closely with CPMs, CTMs, and colleagues across CR\&D in Lachen to support a wide variety of clinical trials  
This position reports to the Global Senior Director CR\&D in Lachen and is a permanent role within the team.  
“Join an international environment with exciting projects and responsibilities — be proactive, contribute, and grow together with a great team”  
\- Dr. Cristina Solomon, Global Vice President CRD Lachen  
Thrive with us  
You help save lives \- Every day is meaningful as we produce life\-saving medicines  
Family values \- Long\-term perspective for employees and relationships  
Be rewarded with market\-related salary and benefits package  
You will have a high level of influence where you can make a difference and leave your footprint  
Work with skilled and fun colleagues in a relatively informal organization  
Skills development \- We offer various internal and external employee and leadership trainings, trainee programs and digital solutions  
It´s in our blood  
We live diversity and stand for equal opportunities as an employer! We therefore look forward to receiving your application \- regardless of age, gender, origin, sexual orientation, and religion.  
Please apply in English.  
Do you have any questions? Then get in touch with your contact person.  
Vignau  
Senior Expert Talent \& Acquisition  
Octapharma AG  
Seidenstrasse 2, 8853 Lachen  
T:  
Want to find out more about us?  
Visit our website Octapharma Career and follow us daily on LinkedIn.  
About Octapharma  
Octapharma is one of the largest human protein manufacturers in the world, developing and producing human proteins from human plasma and human cell lines. We employ more than 11,000 people worldwide to support the treatment of patients in 120 countries with products across three therapeutic areas: Immunotherapy, Haematology and Critical Care. With seven R\&D sites and five state\-of\-the\-art manufacturing facilities in Austria, France, Germany, and Sweden, Octapharma also operates over 195 plasma donation centres across Europe and the US. With four decades of experience, we are committed to advancing patient care worldwide. jpid5481217jm jit0833jm jiy26jm

Legal Counsel

This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded lawyer who enjoys working in a dynamic international environment and partnering closely with business stakeholders to support strategic projects and day\-to\-day operations.  
Missions:  
Provide practical legal advice on corporate, commercial, governance, and operational matters.  
Draft, review, and negotiate a broad range of commercial and corporate agreements.  
Support legal and regulatory compliance across multiple jurisdictions.  
Assist with corporate governance activities, including company incorporations, statutory filings, and corporate records management.  
Advise on contract administration, claims management, and contractual risk allocation.  
Support strategic projects and provide pragmatic legal solutions aligned with business objectives.

Collaborate closely with teams across Commercial, Procurement, Finance, HR, and Operations.  
Contribute to the continuous improvement of legal processes, governance frameworks, and legal operations.

Master in Law or/and qualified lawyer

Exposure to arbitration and dispute resolution matters.  
Experience supporting corporate governance and entity management activities.

Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced international environment.

A varied and challenging legal role within a rapidly growing international organization.  
Exposure to complex cross\-border projects and strategic business initiatives.

Opportunities for professional growth and development.

title: Senior Payroll Specialist
description:
Bei Accelleron kommst du weiter! Aufbauend auf der Erfolgsgeschichte von mehr als 100 Jahren ABB Turbocharging wirst du Teil eines Teams echter Expertinnen und Experten in einem spannenden internationalen Umfeld, die sich gemeinsam für Spitzenleistungen einsetzen. Als vertrauenswürdiger Partner unterstützen wir unsere Kundinnen und Kunden beim Übergang zu nachhaltigen Industrien mit innovativer Technologie, Expertise und intelligenten Lösungen.  
Wir fördern Vielfalt und Inklusion in allen Dimensionen (z. B. Geschlecht, LGBTQ\+, ethnische Zugehörigkeit, Alter, Beeinträchtigung, Religion oder andere Merkmale), da wir individuelle Unterschiede begrüssen und feiern.  
Senior Payroll Specialist (Maternity Leave Cover) (m/f/d; 80\-100%; 10 months)  
In dieser Rolle übernehmen Sie eine auf 10 Monate befristete Mutterschaftsvertretung, idealerweise mit Start per 1\. November, und verantworten die selbständige Durchführung der Lohnverarbeitung für über 1'000 Mitarbeitende. Sie stellen eine korrekte, gesetzeskonforme und termingerechte Payroll über den gesamten Employee Lifecycle sicher und fungieren als Subject Expert für Payroll, Time \& Absence, Sozialversicherungen und Steuern. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Mitarbeitenden, Führungskräften, HR, Finance und externen Stellen beraten Sie zu payrollrelevanten Themen, treiben Prozessverbesserungen voran und stellen die erfolgreiche Durchführung von Audits sowie die Einhaltung aller regulatorischen Anforderungen sicher. Eine strukturierte Einarbeitung sowie eine umfassende Übergabe durch die aktuelle Stelleninhaberin gewährleisten einen reibungslosen Einstieg in die Funktion.  
Ihre Aufgaben:  
Selbständige Durchführung der monatlichen Lohnverarbeitung für über 1'000 Mitarbeitende in der Schweiz.  
Sicherstellung einer korrekten und termingerechten Lohnverarbeitung inklusive Payroll Accounting, Lohnausweisen und Jahresendverarbeitung.  
Pflege und Validierung lohnrelevanter Personal\-, Organisations\- und Vergütungsdaten zur Gewährleistung einer korrekten und gesetzeskonformen Lohnverarbeitung über den gesamten Employee Lifecycle.  
Betreuung und Durchführung payrollrelevanter Prozesse in Workday, SAP und weiteren angebundenen HR\-Systemen.  
Übernahme der Rolle als Subject Expert für Swiss Payroll, Time \& Absence, Sozialversicherungen und Steuern sowie Sicherstellung der Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorgaben und Best Practices.  
Hauptansprechpartner/in für externe Stakeholder (bspw. Sozialversicherungen)  
Bearbeitung und Koordination payrollrelevanter Anfragen und Tickets von Mitarbeitenden, Führungskräften und HR Business Partnern.  
Verarbeitung und Abstimmung von Payroll\-Daten, Erstellung von Payroll\-Auswertungen und Analysen sowie enge Zusammenarbeit mit Finance bei Kontenabstimmungen sowie HR\-relevanten Rückstellungen.  
Verantwortung für interne und externe Payroll\-Audits als zentrale Ansprechperson seitens HR sowie Sicherstellung der termingerechten und korrekten Bereitstellung von Dokumentationen, Daten und Abstimmungen.  
Ihr Profil:  
Kaufmännische Ausbildung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation in Kombination mit einem Diplom als «HR Fachmann / Fachfrau» oder «Sozialversicherungsfachmann / Sozialversicherungsfachfrau» oder Payroll Experte.  
Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Lohnverarbeitung in SAP HCM.  
Fundierte Kenntnisse im Sozialversicherungs\-, Steuer\- und Arbeitsrecht.  
Gute Kenntnisse in Workday und SAP HCM.  
Sehr gute Excel\-Kenntnisse sowie ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten für Payroll\-Reporting, Abstimmungen und Datenvalidierungen.  
Hohe Genauigkeit sowie ein ausgeprägtes Qualitäts\- und Verantwortungsbewusstsein.  
Fähigkeit, Optimierungspotenziale zu erkennen, Verbesserungsinitiativen voranzutreiben und nachhaltige Lösungen pragmatisch umzusetzen.  
Dienstleistungsorientierte, proaktive und selbständige Arbeitsweise.  
Fliessende Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse.  
Ihre Benefits:  
Attraktive Vergütung.  
Kantine.  
Kinderkrippe.  
modene Büroräumlichkeiten, smart working.  
flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle und Arbeitsorte.  
Home\-Office\-Möglichkeiten.  
Employee Assistance Program.  
Betriebliche Sozialberatung.  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
In this role, you will join Accelleron on a 10\-month maternity leave cover assignment, ideally starting on November 1, and independently manage Swiss payroll operations for more than 1,000 employees. You will ensure accurate, compliant and timely payroll processing throughout the employee lifecycle while acting as the subject expert for payroll, time \& absence, social security and tax matters. In close collaboration with employees, managers, HR, Finance and external institutions, you will provide expert guidance, drive continuous process improvements and ensure successful payroll audits and regulatory compliance. A structured onboarding and comprehensive handover from the current role holder will be provided to ensure a smooth transition into the role.  
Your Responsibilities:  
Independently execute the monthly payroll process for a workforce of over 1,000 employees in Switzerland.  
Ensure accurate and timely salary payments, payroll accounting, salary statements and year\-end activities.  
Maintain and validate payroll\-relevant employee, organizational and compensation data to ensure accurate and compliant payroll processing throughout the employee lifecycle.  
Manage payroll\-related activities within Workday, SAP and connected HR systems.

title: Events Planning Manager
description:
Events Planning Manager  
People at 1800m above sea level are shaping the Luxury Mountain Travel. Our dynamic and international community offers our guests smart Luxury for an inimitable holiday experience. As a member of the Luxury Kulm Group you are part of the key to our success. Together, we make every stay deeply inspiring, unique and distinctive. And as such, we embrace our culture: understated luxury, inspiration, and a life experience. Together, we make it happen. This is your chance to be a member of our shaping culture:  
This is what you move with us  
Elegant gala dinners, exclusive weddings, high\-profile business events and bespoke celebrations \- across two of the most distinguished houses in Switzerland. As Events Planning Manager, you guide the entire planning journey from proposal through to operational handover, ensuring that every event is accurately planned, efficiently coordinated and flawlessly executed at both the Kulm Hotel St. and the Grand Hotel Kronenhof Pontresina.  
Your Mission:  
End\-to\-End Event Planning: From the qualified enquiry through proposal and contract to the operational handover \- including accommodation, meeting rooms, catering, technical requirements and personal guest preferences.  
Client Experience: You guide your clients through every stage of the planning process: briefings, site inspections, amendments and professional follow\-up \- always prompt, polished and personalised.  
Administrative Excellence: Preparation of contracts, confirmations, function sheets and Banquet Event Orders (BEOs), maintenance of all event files in PMS and CRM, and monitoring of deposits and payment schedules.  
Operational Interface: You lead the internal event planning meetings and liaise closely with Banqueting, Kitchen, Rooms Division, Reservations, Revenue Management and Front Office across both hotels.  
Leadership \& Development: You lead and coach our Events Coordinator(s) day to day, set priorities and establish shared planning standards, templates and processes.  
Room to Shape: You play an active part in building the new integrated Events organisation of the Kulm Group and develop best practices for both hotels.  
This is you  
Education \& Experience: Bachelor’s degree in hospitality, Events Management or Business Administration and at least three years of experience in hotel events, conference services or event planning, ideally covering meetings, incentives, weddings and private celebrations in the luxury segment.  
Organisational Talent: Outstanding attention to detail, a sure instinct for priorities and the ability to manage several projects simultaneously with composure.  
Process \& Systems Knowledge: Confident command of PMS, CRM and event management systems, along with excellent Microsoft Office 365 skills.  
Personality: Dependable, solution\-oriented and calm under pressure; you build lasting relationships with clients and with every operational department.  
Language Skills: Fluent and stylistically assured German and English, written and spoken; further languages are a plus.  
Start: October or by agreement.  
If you would like to shape the future of Events at the Kulm Group, we look forward to receiving your full application.
